strings.(현대적인 느낌이 물씬 풍기는 엘리아스와는 전혀 다른 분위기를 지닌 고풍: (An elegant old city spreads out before me, its atmosphere entirely different from the modern feel of Elias.)
strings.(이그나트가 해준 이야기대로 큰 제국의 수도였던 도시 같아. 웅장하면서도: (Just as Ignate said, this looks like the former capital of a great empire. Grand and steeped in history.)
strings.(왠지 모르지만, 분위기가 많이 어수선하게 느껴져. 거리를 지나는 사람들: (But something about it feels unsettled. The people passing in the street have a strange anxiety on their faces...)
strings.(그런 그때, %s의 앞으로 약간 불량스러워 보이는 청년 하나가 지나간다: (Just then, a rather roguish-looking young man passes in front of %s.)
strings.와우, 좋은 날씨야. 안 그래? 나, 누구한테 이야기하니. 뭐, 그늘 아: Wow, great weather today. Right? Who am I even talking to? Well, it's perfect for a nap in the shade!
strings.쳇, 맞장구쳐주는 사람도 없고, 다들 우거지 같은 표정이라 죄다 맘에 안: Tch. Nobody answers, and everyone's got a face like thunder. I can't stand it.
Xiaowei would've smiled and said something nice...
strings.하아, 샤오위 누님이 계셨으면 동네 분위기가 조금은 괜찮아졌을까? 누님은: Sigh. Would this place feel a little brighter if Xiaowei were here? Where on earth has she gone?
strings.(조에와 무웬이 이야기했던 그 사람인가?): (Is that the person Zoe and Muwen mentioned?)
strings.당신, 뭐야? 당신 뭔데 누님 이름을 입에 담는 거야? 표정을 보아하니: Who are you? What gives you the right to throw her name around? That look on your face says you know something.
I'm Li Shangtsu. And who might you be? Out with it.
strings.(류싱츠에게 아는 사람이 샤오위에게 안부를 전해달랬다고 간단하게 이야기한: (I briefly explain to Li Shangtsu that a friend asked me to pass on their regards to Xiaowei. His expression finally softens.)
You're with the people she mentioned. All right, I can trust you.
strings.종종 자리를 비우시긴 하지만, 이번엔 기간이 좀 긴 것 같네요. 찾는 분: She disappears now and then, but she's been gone longer than usual this time. A lot of people are looking for her, so I've been searching too. Who knows when she'll turn up...
strings.그러면 같이 찾아보실래요? 저는 저대로 여기저기 돌아봤는데, 아직 거기는: Want to help me look? I've tried all sorts of places, but there's one I haven't checked yet.
strings.붉은 수수밭이라고 풍차가 세워져 있는 곳이 있어요.종종 어떤 할아버지가: The Red Crop Field, where the windmill stands. An old man shows up there sometimes. Someone saw her chatting with him.
Then I'll go and ask him.
All right. I'm counting on you.
strings.(한적한 붉은 수수밭 사이에서 무슨 일 때문인지 난처한 표정의 노인이 보: (An old man stands among the quiet Red Crop Field, looking troubled about something.)
strings.에잉, 큰일이군. 이거 큰일이야. 내가 이런 실수를 하다니…. 정말 귀찮: Oh dear, this is bad. Very bad. How could I make a mistake like that...? What a nuisance.
strings.(기묘한 분위기의 가면을 착용한 노인이 인기척을 느꼈는지 이쪽을 바라본다: (The old man in an oddly mysterious mask seems to notice my presence and looks this way.)
strings.(샤오위와 종종 담소를 나눴다던 그 노인인지 물어본다.): (I ask whether he is the old man who often chats with Xiaowei.)
strings.맞네. 그 청년이 말한 노인이 바로 나인 것 같군. 나는 종리권이라고 하: Indeed. I believe I'm the old man that youngster mentioned. My name is Zhongli Quan. I often chat with our lady immortal.
Do you have a moment? I'd like you to help me.
strings.실은 말일세. 내 구름을 타고 이 땅을 지나다 문득 산천에서 흉흉한 기운: Well, you see, I was riding my cloud over this land when I noticed an ominous energy gathering in the mountains and rivers.
strings.구름 타는 신선 처음 보는가?: Never seen a cloud-riding immortal before?
No need to concern yourself too much with that.
strings.(종리권의 앞으로 신비한 느낌이 드는 구름 한 점이 조용히 다가와 멈춘다: (A cloud with a mysterious air quietly drifts over and stops before Zhongli Quan.)
strings.이제 이해가 됐는가? 하여튼 내가 흉흉한 기운 때문에 뭔가 큰일이 날까: Understand now? Anyway, I feared that sinister energy might cause a disaster, so I gathered it up and stuffed it into a pouch...
strings.이야기가 빠르군. 날 좀 도와 재앙의 씨앗을 모아줬으면 하네. 이 씨앗이: Quick on the uptake! I'd like you to help me gather the Seeds of Calamity. They started thrashing about inside the pouch, then burst out in midair and fell down here...
strings.재앙의 씨앗이 싹을 트면 큰일이 터질 게야. 용경부터 해서 이 대륙을 삼: If those seeds sprout, there'll be a catastrophe. They might swallow this whole continent, starting with Yong Gyoung...
And you'll never see the Xiaowei you're looking for.
...Forgive me for making such a shameless request. My old eyes aren't what they used to be...
I'm only a low-ranking immortal, with so much work and stress that I'm forever coming down with something...
strings.(왠지 잘못 걸린 것 같은 기분이 드네.): (I have a feeling I've gotten myself into trouble.)
strings.정말인가?! 자네는 정말 훌륭한 자일세. 이렇게 영험한 기운을 지닌 자네: Really?! What a splendid person you are! With such an extraordinary aura, you'll find them in no time.
strings.(종리권이 %s의 두 손을 덥썩 붙잡는다.): (Zhongli Quan eagerly clasps both of %s's hands.)
strings.참 이리도 염치없는 선인이라 생각지 말게…. 흑흑. 하여튼! 근처에서 재: Please don't think me an utterly shameless immortal... Sob, sob. Anyway! Find the Seeds of Calamity nearby.
Once they start growing, they're practically monster feed...
strings.허허허허…. 미안하네. 회수만 제대로 해준다면 내 샤오위가 어디로 갔는지: Hohoho... Sorry about all this. Bring them all back safely, and I'll tell you where Xiaowei went.
All right. I'll go find them.
strings.(저 어르신, 가면 뒤로 살짝 웃고 있는 것 같은데…. 기분 탓인가?): (Is that a little smile behind his mask...? Or am I imagining it?)
strings.(종리권이 재앙의 씨앗을 받더니 좀처럼 말을 이어가지 못한다.): (Zhongli Quan takes the Seeds of Calamity, then seems at a loss for words.)
strings.아, 내가 잠깐 정신줄을 놨네. 미안허이. 그 아이는 샹그리라로 들어갔네: Ah, my mind wandered for a moment. My apologies. That girl went into Shangri-La. Hurry, and you might catch her.
Thank you. It was nice meeting you, sir.
Yes, take care. Oh, wait... I had something to tell you, but you're already gone.
I meant to say that finding the way is difficult unless you're an immortal...
strings.(샹그리라 제일 안쪽이 시끄러워서 들어가 보니 어떤 여성이 거대한 괴물과: (I follow a commotion deep inside Shangri-La and find a woman facing an enormous monster.)
strings.(괴물이 금방이라도 여성을 짓밟아버릴 것 같다. 하지만, 여성 또한 만만: (The monster looks ready to trample her at any moment, but she meets its gaze with a formidable presence of her own.)
strings.그릇된 길에 빠져든 자, 현무여. 지금의 당신은 나를 넘어서 갈 수 없습: Hyunmu, you who have strayed from the right path. As you are now, you cannot get past me.
strings.(%s의 목소리에 여인이 당황한 듯 뒤를 돌아본다.): (At the sound of %s's voice, the woman turns around in surprise.)
strings.누구죠? 절 어떻게 알고? 아니, 아무도 못 들어오게 결계를 펼쳤는데,: Who are you? How do you know me? Wait, I put up a barrier to keep everyone out. How did you...? No, that can wait.
strings.저기요, 어서 피하세요!!: You there, get out of the way!!
strings.(샤오위의 말과 함께 현무의 눈빛이 변했다.): (As Xiaowei speaks, the look in Hyunmu's eyes changes.)
strings.(분명 현무는 가만히 있는데, 눈앞으로 다가오는 것 같아. 점점 몸이 굳: (Hyunmu hasn't moved, but it feels as though it's coming right at me. My body is stiffening... It feels like something is binding me...)
strings.(현무에게서 수상한 기운이 빠른 속도로 흘러나오는 순간, 샤오위가 %s: (The instant a strange energy surges out from Hyunmu, Xiaowei steps in front of %s.)
I'll help you too. It's still a little hard to move, but...
strings.물러나세요. 저 괴물은 당신이 상대할 수 있는 그런 게 아니에요!: Stay back! That monster is beyond anything you can handle!
But you got hurt because of me...
Well, well. Looks like things have gotten awkward.
strings.(어디선가 어떤 여인의 목소리가 들려온다.): (A woman's voice comes from somewhere nearby.)
strings.이 못된 거북이 녀석! 거기 가만히 있어!!: You wicked turtle! Stay right there!!
(As the woman addresses Hyunmu, it backs away for a moment, seemingly flustered.)
strings.(순간, 온몸을 묶고 있던 수상한 기운이 사라져 몸이 가벼워지는 게 느껴: (In an instant, the strange energy binding my body disappears, and I feel light again.)
strings.자, 지금이야! 두 사람!! 이쪽으로 와!!: Now! Both of you! Over here!!
Yes, yes. Yangso Lan Caihe isn't going anywhere.
Oh dear, Xiao's passed out. Look what happened to that pretty face...
Oh, it's you. You seem all right.
I'm glad you've still got the strength to talk.
strings.그래, 그래. 신선 정도의 기운을 가진 자가 아니면 현무를 만날 수도 없: Yes, yes. Without an aura on the level of an immortal's, you could scarcely encounter Hyunmu, let alone escape.
strings.(어르신이 사매라 부른 저분도 신선이겠지?): (The woman he called his junior sister must be an immortal too.)
strings.자네가 생각하는 그게 맞네. 그나저나 현무 녀석이 이쪽으로 올 생각은 없: Exactly what you're thinking. At any rate, Hyunmu doesn't seem inclined to follow us here. What do you think, Junior Sister?
Your formidable presence keeps the creature at bay, Senior Brother.
Kind of you to say so. Hohoho.
strings.거북이 녀석이 제법 판단력이 있는 듯합니다. 사형의 기운을 느끼더니 쫓아: That turtle seems to have some sense. It felt your aura and decided not to pursue us.
You could have finished it off for me.
strings.저처럼 가녀린 이가 싸움을 즐길 리 없잖습니까?: Surely you don't think a delicate woman like me enjoys fighting?
Besides, the affairs of the mortal realm should be settled by mortals.
strings.(신선들의 이야기라 전혀 모르겠네….): (I can't make heads or tails of these immortals' conversation...)
strings.(신선들의 대화가 이어질 때쯤 샤오위가 정신을 차리고 일어난다.): (As the immortals continue talking, Xiaowei regains consciousness and sits up.)
Ah, Master Zhengyang. And Master Yangso...
You're awake? Not too badly hurt? Thank goodness for that.
strings.사형, 아끼는 아이한테 그 정도밖에 못해주십니까? 샤오, 잠깐 얼굴 보자: Senior Brother, is that all you can do for a child you're so fond of? Xiao, let me see your face.
strings.어머, 이 예쁜 얼굴에 생채기라니. 거북이 녀석 용서하지 않겠어!: Oh my, scratches on that beautiful face! That turtle will pay!
Master Yangso, I'm fine. My lack of training has caused you needless worry.
You've lost a lot of strength. Don't face opponents like that for a while.
I can't protect Yong Gyoung like this.
strings.자네, 이런 일로 상심하지 말게나. 어우, 울면 안 되네. 웃게, 웃으면: Don't let this get you down. Oh dear, no tears now. Smile! You know what they say: good fortune comes to those who smile.
strings.이 요물을 당장 내 손으로!!: I'll deal with that vile creature myself!!
strings.사형, 검선의 길을 걷는 후학이 아무리 소중해도 저희가 참견해선 안 됩니: Senior Brother, however dear this aspiring sword immortal may be to us, we must not interfere.
Oh, forgive me for not introducing myself sooner.
strings.저는 %s…라고 해요. 조에와 무웬이 안부 전해달라고 해서 용경에 왔는데: My name is... %s. Zoe and Muwen asked me to pass on their regards, so I came to Yong Gyoung...
strings.(간단하게 자기소개를 하고, 용경의 사람들이 샤오위를 찾고 있는 것 같다: (I briefly introduce myself and explain that the people of Yong Gyoung seem to be looking for Xiaowei.)
strings.많은 분들에게 걱정을 끼쳤네요. 이야기해주셔서 고마워요. 미안해하실 필요: I've worried so many people. Thank you for telling me. You have nothing to apologize for.
Young lady, you should rest. In this state, we'd feel bad even making our offer.
strings.샤오위 소저는 선적에 오른 훌륭한 가문 출신일세. 특히 소저의 자질은 더: Miss Xiaowei comes from a distinguished family whose members have attained immortality. Her own potential is exceptional. Young as she is, her swordsmanship and diligence set an example for others.
strings.더불어 고운 목소리와 춤선, 악기로 음을 자유자재로 다루는 경지는 극에: And her lovely voice, graceful dancing, and mastery of musical instruments have reached extraordinary heights. I'd like to make Xiao an immortal of music...
strings.그런데 저 현무 녀석이 나타나 방해를 하다니…. 내가 좀 손을 쓰고 싶지: But then that Hyunmu appeared and got in the way... I'd like to do something, but being forbidden to meddle in mortal affairs is frustrating.
strings.손을 댔다간 윗분께서 필시 경을 치실테고, 이곳의 사람들도 대응할 수도: If I intervened, our superiors would surely punish me, and things would happen that the people here couldn't possibly handle. Utter chaos...
strings.이해가 잘 안 되면 나중에 신선들의 이야기를 다룬 어쩌구 연의란 책을 읽: If that doesn't make sense, read that book about immortals someday. Romance of... something or other.
strings.네, 그럴게요. 아, 샤오위. 괜찮아요?: All right, I will. Oh, Xiaowei. Are you feeling all right?
Master Zhengyang... I know it's shameless for one so unworthy to ask... but please lend me your strength.
strings.이거 소저가 부탁하는데 모른 척, 할 수도 없고, 지금 우리도 꽤 눈치를: Well, when you ask like that, I can hardly turn a blind eye. But we have to be rather careful ourselves just now...
strings.얼마 전, 어쩌다 보니 용왕들과 싸우면서 태산을 뽑아 용궁 지붕에 꽂은: Not long ago, we somehow ended up fighting the Dragon Kings, uprooting Mount Tai, and planting it in the roof of the Dragon Palace...
strings.그 일은 저쪽에서 먼저 잘못했지만, 뭐…. 어쩔 수 없지. 그러면 서왕모: They started it, mind you. Still... it can't be helped. I'll offer a tiny bit of help, out of the Queen Mother of the West's sight.
strings.사매, 괜찮겠나?: Will that be all right, Junior Sister?
How generous of you, Senior Brother. And what help will you offer?
My junior sister here is the finest talent among the Eight Immortals. Our greatest strategist!
strings.거, 좋은 방법이긴 합니다만, 너무 무책임하신 거 아닙니까?: Well, it's a good approach, but isn't that rather irresponsible of you?
strings.허허허, 자네라면 선계에서도 최고 아닌가?: Hohoho! Aren't you the best even in the immortal realm?
strings.하여튼, 거기 모험가? 마침 좋은 환경이군요. 제가 도움을 드릴 터이니: Anyway, you there, adventurer? The setting is just right. I'll help you, so would you gather a few ingredients for me?
strings.거기 또 누가 있나요? 하여튼 하늘의 지혜를 빌어 현무를 물리칠만한 비: Who else is standing there? Anyway, I'll draw on heavenly wisdom to make an elixir that will let you defeat Hyunmu. It's nothing difficult, so don't be afraid.
I need [Ancient Ginseng]. I'm sorry this is all the help I can offer.
No, it's all right. I'll do it.
Good luck. Surprisingly quick to act, aren't they? Already gone...
Thank you... For helping someone so unworthy...
Just get some rest, Xiao. For that child's sake too.
I'm surprised they found it so quickly. Perhaps they are...
Shh, Junior Sister. For now, we're only here to help.
I'm back. It wasn't as hard to find as I expected.
strings.좋아요. 비약을 만드는 건 어렵지 않을테니 잠깐 우리 사형 말벗이나 해주: Good. The elixir won't be difficult to make. Keep my senior brother company for a moment.
strings.걱정하지 않아도 되네. 잠깐 잠들었으니까. 어떤 주제로 이야기할까? 자네: Don't worry. She's just asleep for a little while. What shall we talk about? Do you like idols?
Yes, idols. There's one I'm quite fond of lately...
Hoho, what a shame. I could have talked for hours.
strings.비약 제조가 이렇게 빨리 끝난 걸 다행으로 여기세요. 안 그러면 사형이: Be thankful I finished so quickly. Otherwise, he'd have spent the whole night reciting everything he likes about his favorite idol.
strings.자, 이걸 쭉 들이켜요. 모험가, 당신에게 좋은 기운이…. 어라, 의심하: Here, drink it all down. Adventurer, a fine energy will... Hmm? Don't you trust me?
strings.그럼 짧게 설명하죠. 사형과 나, 모두 여덟 명의 선인을 팔선이라 불러요: Then let me explain briefly. My senior brother, myself, and six others are known as the Eight Immortals. This medicine will connect our spirits to yours...
strings.어려운 말일지도 모르겠네, 사매. 쉽게 말해 우리의 힘을 자네가 살짝: That may be a bit complicated, Junior Sister. Put simply, you'll borrow a little of our power. Mortals must handle mortal affairs, but when things get difficult, we sometimes do this.
strings.신선의 힘을 쓰는 약인데 마셔도 괜찮을까요?: It's medicine that gives me an immortal's power. Is it safe to drink?
strings.하하, 이래 죽으나 저래 죽으나 피차일반 아닐까요?: Hahaha! Dead this way or dead that way, what's the difference?
Oops, that came out wrong. Just drink it down.
strings.…맛은 없지만, 힘이 생긴 것 같은 기분이예요. 이제 어떻게 하면 되나요: ...It tastes awful, but I feel stronger. What should I do now?
Go and defeat Hyunmu. You're connected to the power of the Eight Immortals, so it shouldn't be too difficult.
Xiaowei got hurt because of me. I'll take care of this.
Believe in me. Believe in us. You may find strength you never had before.
Yes, I believe you. I'll go defeat Hyunmu now.
Off you go. Don't worry too much.
strings.사매, 저 모험가 어떻게 생각하는가?: Junior Sister, what do you make of that adventurer?
strings.저 모험가는 잘 할 수 있을 겁니다. 팔선의 비약을 먹고도 살아있는 하계: That adventurer will do well. A mortal who survived drinking the Elixir of the Eight Immortals, after all.
strings.그렇긴 하네만…. 그럼 지켜보도록 할까?: True enough... Shall we watch, then?
Let's. And it's about time Xiao woke up.
strings.(현무가 쓰러진 후, 알 수 없는 기운이 공간 가득 채워지기 시작한다.): (After Hyunmu falls, an unknown energy begins to fill the space.)
strings.(그동안 보이지 않았던 현무의 보물들이 눈에 들어오기 시작한다.): (Hyunmu's treasures, which I hadn't noticed before, begin to catch my eye.)
Can I take them? I defeated Hyunmu, so... I...
strings.(알 수 없는 감정에 사로잡힌다. 분명 방금까진 이런 기분이 아니었는데…: (An unfamiliar emotion takes hold of me. I certainly didn't feel this way a moment ago...)
strings.(저 멀리 샤오위가 나타나 환한 얼굴로 %s에게 다가간다.): (Xiaowei appears in the distance and approaches %s with a bright smile.)
strings.이제 현무의 사악한 기운에 물든 재물을 파괴하고 샹그리라를 정화하면 돼요: Now we just need to destroy the treasures tainted by its evil aura and purify Shangri-La. Then we'll set up a barrier to keep evil beings like Hyunmu away, and everything will be...
strings.(샤오위가 뭐라고 말하고 있지만, 들려오지 않아….): (Xiaowei is saying something, but I can't hear it...)
strings.이건 다 내 거야!! 이걸 다 가져가겠다고? 그렇게는 안 두겠어!: This is all mine!! You're going to take it all away? I won't let you!
strings.물러나. 이건 다 내거야!: Stay back. This is all mine!
strings.정신 차리셔야 합니다! 지금 %s 님은 남아있는 현무의 사악한 술법에 말: You must come to your senses! %s, you've fallen under the lingering effects of Hyunmu's evil spell!
strings.(지금 내가 할 수 있을까? 물러나야 할까? 내버려둔다면 저 사람은 또: (Can I do this in my condition? Should I retreat? But if I leave them, they'll become another Hyunmu.)
strings.(위험한 걸 알면서 맞서 싸워준 사람을 그대로 둘 순 없어.): (I can't abandon someone who fought despite knowing the danger.)
...Then I have no choice. I will face you myself.
strings.(무기를 들고 다가오는 걸 보면 여기 있는 보물을 탐하고 있는 게 분명해: (She's coming at me with a weapon. She must be after the treasure here! I have to defeat her...)
I'll save you. Just hold on a little longer.
strings.(방금 공격의 충격으로 샤오위가 멀리 튕겨 나갔다.): (The impact of the last attack sends Xiaowei flying.)
strings.어딜 내 보물을 가져가려고!! 하압!: Don't you dare take my treasure!! Hah!
I'm sorry... I should have saved you...
strings.(샤오위가 주저앉아 일어나지 못하고 있다.): (Xiaowei sinks to the ground, unable to get up.)
strings.이 보물은 내 거야. 다른 사람이 손 대는 건 가만 두지않겠어. 그러니까: This treasure is mine. I won't let anyone else touch it. So...
strings.(샤오위를 향해 무기를 들었을 때, 어디선가 강한 힘이 현무동을 뒤흔든다: (A powerful force shakes Hyunmu's Cave just as the weapon is raised toward Xiaowei, knocking it from %s's hand to the floor.)
strings.(뒤이어 힘 있는 남자의 목소리가 들려오고, 시선이 자연스레 그쪽으로 향: (A commanding male voice follows, and my gaze turns naturally toward it.)
strings.샤오위 양, 이런 건 나한테 맡겨달라고. 알잖아. 내가 이쪽 담당이란 걸: Miss Xiaowei, leave this sort of thing to me. You know this is my department.
strings.(수상한 남자가 작은 목소리로 이쪽을 향해 중얼거린다.): (The suspicious man murmurs something quietly in my direction.)
strings.그래, 너! 네가 해치려는 상대가 누구인지 똑똑히 봐라!!: Yes, you! Take a good look at the person you're about to hurt!!
Obviously, someone trying to steal my treasure...
strings.(머릿속이 복잡해…. 저 남자는 그냥 내 앞에 있는 것 뿐인데, 알 수: (My mind is in turmoil... The man is just standing in front of me, but I feel an unknown power.)
strings.(어둠 속에서 뭔가 타오르고 있는 느낌이야. 나를 꿰뚫고 있어….): (It feels like something is burning in the darkness. Piercing right through me...)
strings.(%s의 정신이 돌아왔을 때, 수트를 잘 차려 입은 청년이 서 있다. 청: (When %s comes to, a smartly suited young man stands nearby. After checking %s's condition, he helps Xiaowei up.)
strings.정신을 차렸군. 현무에게서 돌아오려면 꽤 오래 걸릴텐데, 정신력이 제법: You're back. Recovering from Hyunmu's influence should take quite some time. Perhaps you have a strong will...?
strings.내가 왜 그랬지…. 아, 샤오위! 샤오위! 괜찮아요?: Why did I do that...? Oh, Xiaowei! Xiaowei! Are you all right?
I'm fine. More importantly, thank you for stopping them, Kazno.
strings.(어디선가 들어본 이름이다…. 분명 어디선가…. 어디서지…?): (I've heard that name somewhere... Definitely somewhere... Where was it...?)
strings.샤오위 양, 이렇게 상처를 입으면 연주하기 힘들지 않겠어?: Miss Xiaowei, it'll be hard to perform with injuries like these, won't it?
strings.(카즈노라 불린 남자가 샤오위의 상처에 손을 올려놓는다. 어떤 힘으로 상: (The man called Kazno places a hand over Xiaowei's wounds. As some power gradually closes them, her expression relaxes.)
Thank you. I've felt this power before, but it's still amazing to see.
strings.샤오! 샤오! 괜찮아?: Xiao! Xiao! Are you all right?
strings.(남채화와 종리권이 종종걸음으로 다가온다.): (Lan Caihe and Zhongli Quan hurry over.)
I'm fine, Master Zhengyang, Master Yangso.
strings.이 친구의 기운이 흐려져서 달려왔는데, 다행히 잘 마무리된 것 같군. 어: We came running when this youngster's aura grew dim, but it seems everything has been resolved. Oh, you're...
I'm surprised an immortal knows me. I'm flattered.
It would be harder not to recognize someone as famous as you.
strings.저기 카즈노란 분은 유명한 사람인가요?: Excuse me, is this Kazno person famous?
strings.(…적당히 이야기해줘야겠군. 사매, 부탁허이.): (...We'd better give a suitable explanation. Junior Sister, if you would.)
A master who conquered the Elias Arena and saved the Elias royal family from a crisis...
strings.후우, 바람둥이라니. 내가 아무리 인기가 많아도 그런 식으로 인식하는 건: Sigh. A womanizer? Popular as I may be, that's hardly a fair way to see me.
Just from what I've seen myself... Oh, never mind.
Excuse me, Kazno. There's something I'd like to ask...
strings.아, 시간이 이렇게 됐군. 샤오위 양, 잘 지내. 다른 분들도 안녕, 잘: Oh, look at the time. Take care, Miss Xiaowei. Goodbye to the rest of you too. Stay well.
strings.(카즈노가 그렇게 자기 할 말만 하고 사라졌다.): (Having said only what he wanted to say, Kazno disappears.)
strings.(사매, 아무래도 그가 눈치를 차린 것 같지?): (Junior Sister, it seems he noticed, doesn't it?)
strings.(여기서 제압할 걸 그랬나요? 가능했을지도 의문이지만요….): (Should we have subdued him here? Though I'm not sure we could have...)
strings.(레이레이가 나타났다면 또 모르겠지만 말이야.): (Perhaps if Lei Lei had appeared, things might be different.)
strings.(레이는 자신과 관련된 일이 아니면 별 관심이 없으니까요. 그래도…. 아: (Lei has little interest in anything unrelated to herself. Still... Ah, shall we stop here? I think we're about to be noticed.)
strings.두 분은 왜 그리 아무 말도 없이 서 있으세요?: Why are you two just standing there without saying anything?
strings.(종리권과 남채화가 서로를 보며 씨익 웃는다.): (Zhongli Quan and Lan Caihe exchange broad smiles.)
strings.자, 이만 돌아갈까? 사매, 나는 샤오위 양을 데려다 줄터이니, 샹그리라: Well, shall we head back? Junior Sister, I'll take Miss Xiaowei home. Please put a barrier around Shangri-La.
strings.그러지요. 샤오를 잘 부탁드립니다. 어떻게 결계를 쳐야 잘 쳤다고 소문이: Of course. Take good care of Xiao. Now, what sort of barrier will earn me a fine reputation? Hehehe.
strings.(뭔가 내가 모르는 일이 일어난 것 같은데….): (It feels like something happened that I don't understand...)
strings.오늘 감사드려요. 큰 은혜를 입었어요. 용경에 오시면 꼭 저를 찾아주세요: Thank you for today. I owe you a great debt. Be sure to visit me when you're in Yong Gyoung.
No, I'm the one who did something terrible, and you...
Don't let that trouble you too much. We'll be going now.
strings.방금 온 구름이 꽤 튼튼하니 별일 없이 용경에 당도할 수 있을 게야. 아: The cloud that just arrived is quite sturdy. We should reach Yong Gyoung without incident. Oh, you should visit Aoich.
strings.거기도 재미있는 곳이죠. 그럼 다들 나중에 만나요. 부디 별 일 없어야: That's an interesting place too. See you all later. Do stay out of trouble.
strings.(인사가 끝나자마자 선인들이 구름을 타고 하늘로 오른다. 잠시 후, 구름: (As soon as the farewells are over, the immortals ride their clouds into the sky. Soon the clouds disappear in the directions of their respective destinations.)
strings.그럼 아오이치로 가볼까?: Shall I head to Aoich, then?
strings.(용경만큼이나 화려하고 고풍스럽고 멋진 건물이 잔뜩 세워져 있다.): (Splendid old buildings, every bit as ornate and impressive as those of Yong Gyoung, fill the view.)
strings.(그에 반해 거리의 분위기는 차분하고 조용한 것 같다… 라고 느낄 때쯤…: (By contrast, the streets seem calm and quiet... Or so I think, until...)
strings.(저 뒤에서 시끄러운 소리가 들려온다.): (A loud commotion comes from behind me.)
strings.(일단 비켜서 상황을 지켜보자.): (I'd better step aside and see what happens.)
strings.거기 서! 아메! 도망치지 마!: Stop right there, Ame! Don't run away!
strings.(아메라 불린 여성이 누군가에 쫓겨 숨을 곳이 없는지 한참 동안 두리번거: (The woman called Ame, pursued by someone, looks around desperately for a hiding place.)
Tch. No choice. I can't let Tamori catch me like this...
strings.(아메가 도로 한쪽에 흐르는 강을 바라보더니 순식간에 몸을 던진다.): (Ame glances at the river beside the road, then throws herself into it in a flash.)
strings.(물속에서 아메의 얼굴이 올라온다. 별 일 없다는 것처럼 능숙한 솜씨로: (Ame's head emerges from the water. As though nothing is wrong, she deftly swims through the current and heads away.)
Whew. Lost her. This is bad...
strings.(잠시 후, 인파 속에서 한 남성이 나와 걱정스러운 표정으로 강을 바라본: (A moment later, a man emerges from the crowd and stares anxiously at the river. From what people are saying, he seems to be the man called 'Tamori.')
If she keeps breaking into the castle and the other shikigami catch her, everyone will be in trouble... It's the same thing every time with her. Sigh...
Something seems to be going on.
strings.타모리, 갔지? 간 거 맞지?: Tamori's gone, right? He's really gone?
You're the one who went into the water...
strings.맞아. 맞아. 아까 그랬었지. 후우, 맘에 드는 옷이 더럽혀져서 물에 들: Yep, yep. That was me. Whew. I didn't want to jump in and ruin my favorite outfit, but I had no choice.
strings.나하고 저기 흑월성에 사는 공주, 흑월공주가 친구거든. 요즘 흑월성 분위: I'm friends with the princess who lives in Dark Moon Castle over there. The Dark Moon Princess. Things at the castle have felt strange lately, so I went to check on her.
strings.그런데 쫓아내지 뭐야!! 잔뜩 화도 나고. 그래서 어떻게든 알고 싶어서: And they threw me out!! I was furious. So I've been trying to sneak in and find out what's going on, but it's not working. I keep getting spotted and chased off.
strings.특히 저 타모리란 무사장, 보통이 아니지. 일반 닌자들보다 더하면 더 했: That warrior captain Tamori is especially tough. He's at least as good as any regular ninja, if not better. But still! Next time I won't lose! I'm getting in!
strings.(아메가 전의를 불태우며 또 도전을 다짐하고 있다.): (Ame burns with determination, vowing to try again.)
strings.(아메에게 타모리가 했던 혼잣말의 내용을 이야기한다.): (I tell Ame what Tamori was muttering to himself.)
Oh, really? What should I do?
strings.저기 당신, 복장 보니 모험가 같은데 맞지?: Hey, judging by your clothes, you're an adventurer, right?
strings.다른 모험가는 의뢰 같은 걸 받는데, 당신도 그래? 내가 정식으로 의뢰할: Other adventurers take commissions. Do you? I'll make it an official job, so help me out!!
strings.어쩔 수 없죠. 그러면 제가 어떻게 하면 되죠?: All right, I suppose. What do you want me to do?
strings.별거 아냐! 성에 들어가서 흑월공주를 만나. 공주가 잘 있는 거 보고 이: Nothing much! Go into the castle and meet the Dark Moon Princess. Make sure she's all right and give her this letter!
strings.아메가 걱정하고 있다고만 전해줘. 보수는 제대로 준비할테니까 너무 걱정하: Just tell her Ame is worried about her. I'll have your payment ready, so don't worry about that.
strings.(부탁을 받았으니 가보는 수밖에 없겠네.): (I've accepted the request, so I suppose I have to go.)
strings.흑월성은 안쪽으로 쭉 가면 돼. 그럼 부탁해!: Just keep heading inward to reach Dark Moon Castle. I'm counting on you!
strings.이런 침입자에게 내가 밀리다니, 믿을 수 없어!: I can't believe an intruder like you is pushing me back!
strings.(만나자마자 다짜고짜 공격해오던 소녀가 한 발 물러나 불만을 터뜨린다.): (The girl who attacked without warning the moment we met steps back and voices her frustration.)
strings.저기, 제 말 좀 들어봐요. 공주 맞죠? 흑월공주?: Please, just hear me out. You're the princess, right? The Dark Moon Princess?
That's right. And I still have no intention of listening.
What shall I do with this intruder? I suppose I'll have to fight hard enough to bring the castle down.
I'll hear your excuses in the dungeon.
strings.(흑월공주의 눈빛이 변한다.): (The look in the Dark Moon Princess's eyes changes.)
strings.(뭐야? 조금 전까지 상대했던 사람이 아닌 것 같잖아. 이 무서운 힘은: (What? It's like she's a completely different person from a moment ago. Where is this terrifying power coming from...?)
strings.전투 중에 다른 생각 하고 있네?: Your mind is wandering in the middle of a fight?
strings.(그제야 흑월공주가 쏜 화살이 눈앞에 들어온다. 하지만, 어디선가 날아온: (Only then do I notice the arrow the Dark Moon Princess has fired. But a small fan flies in from somewhere and knocks it down.)
My daughter is wonderful in every way, except for that hasty temper. Cough.
strings.아버님? 지금 나오시면 위험해요! 저 침입자는 보통이 아닌 것 같다구요!: Father? It's dangerous for you to come out now! This intruder is no ordinary foe!
strings.괜찮아, 괜찮아. 공주님. 잘 보지 않겠니? 저 침입자 친구는 적의가 없: It's all right, my princess. Take a good look, won't you? Our intruder friend doesn't seem hostile.
strings.(안색은 좋지 않지만, 그래도 인상이 좋아보이는 청년이 흑월공주와 함께: (A pale but pleasant-looking young man studies %s's face alongside the Dark Moon Princess.)
Oh, if you're the princess's father...
strings.맞네. 내가 이 성의 주인 흑월성주지. 남들이 보면 공주의 오빠 정도로: Indeed. I am the master of this castle, the Dark Moon Lord. Others might mistake me for her older brother, but I am her father.
Father, one more remark like that and you can forget the snack I was going to bring you.
strings.미안하다, 우리 딸. 흑월성을 노리는 자들 때문에 우리 사랑스러운 딸 심: Forgive me, my dear daughter. You're already upset about those plotting against Dark Moon Castle. I shouldn't add to your troubles.
Cough, cough. I'm sorry my chronic illness has left me in such a sorry state.
Father, I know you're fine right now.
My beloved princess has seen right through me.
strings.네, 아버님. 무리는 하지 마세요. 그나저나 거기 너 말이야. 왜 온 거: Yes, Father. Don't overdo it. Now then, you there. Why did you come? Explain yourself.
I've been asking you to listen this whole time...
strings.자네, 기분 풀게. 무슨 일로 찾아온 건지 이야기를 해주겠나?: Please don't be upset. Would you tell us what brings you here?
strings.(아메가 부탁한 편지를 흑월공주에게 전달한다.): (I hand Ame's letter to the Dark Moon Princess.)
strings.자네도 대단하군. 편지를 전하러 여기까지 들어온 실력자라는 건데. 하여튼: You're quite remarkable yourself. Making it all the way here to deliver a letter takes real skill. At any rate, thank you.
strings.미안해, 다른 목적이 있어서 온 줄 알았거든. 그리고 아메의 편지를 가져: Sorry. I thought you'd come for some other purpose. And thank you for bringing Ame's letter. I'll contact her right away.
strings.일이 끝났으니 저는 돌아갈게요. 어, 공주님?: My job is done, so I'll be leaving. Huh, Princess?
strings.(흑월공주가 %s의 옷자락을 붙잡는다. 뭔가 할 이야기가 있어보인다.): (The Dark Moon Princess catches %s by the hem of their clothes. She seems to have something to say.)
Ahem. You there. Go wait outside. I'll be right there.
strings.네 실력이 괜찮아 보이는데, 내가 임무를 하나 줄 거야. 사양말고 받들도: You seem reasonably capable, so I'm giving you a mission. Accept it without complaint.
strings.거절한다는 선택지는 없어. 내가 거절할 테니까. 임무를 해결한다면 성 안: Refusing isn't an option. I'll refuse your refusal. Complete the mission, and I'll graciously forgive the disturbance you caused inside the castle.
strings.(뭔가 귀찮은 일 같은데…, 그냥 빨리 해야겠다.): (This sounds like trouble... I'd better just get it over with.)
strings.자, 집중, 집중! 어차피 빨리 해치워야겠다는 생각 뿐이지?: Now, pay attention! All you're thinking is that you should get it over with quickly, aren't you?
You're so easy to read. Listen carefully. I'll explain.
strings.흑월성의 보물 중에는 '마이노의 보석'이란 게 있어. 사용자의 마력을 무: Among Dark Moon Castle's treasures is something called 'Mino's Jewel.' It can expand its user's magical power without limit. Such a priceless treasure...
Father, I know what you're going to say. Please leave this to me.
strings.몇 년 전, 여기서 일어난 싸움 때문에 보석에 금이 갔어. 금이 가도 괜: A few years ago, a battle here cracked the jewel. We thought a crack wouldn't matter... But its magical power began to disappear.
Sigh... It was the work of the traitors from Owl Castle who were after my father.
strings.수리할 방법은 없나요?: Is there a way to repair it?
strings.그게 수리를 맡기는 게 좀 어려워. 그 보석이 없으면 우리 흑월성의 수호: Sending it away for repairs is difficult. Without it, we have trouble summoning Tengu, the guardian deity of Dark Moon Castle.
strings.텐구처럼 높은 수호신을 소환하는 건 위대한 주술사인 아버님이라 해도 부담: Summoning a guardian as powerful as Tengu strains even a great shaman like my father...
To think my daughter respects me so deeply! Your father is moved to tears.
My esteemed father, please compose yourself.
To keep Tengu summoned and preserve my father's health...
You look unconvinced... There's another Mino's Jewel in Elfa. One just like ours.
strings.그걸 빌려와줬으면 좋겠어. 사막민족의 지도자이자 대전사라 불리는 카디프,: I'd like you to borrow it. Meet Cardiff, the leader of the desert people and their great warrior, and explain the situation.
strings.응. 사실 내가 가고 싶지만, 흑월성도 불안하고, 아버님 상태도 봐야해서: Yes. I'd like to go myself, but Dark Moon Castle is unsettled, and I need to watch over my father...
This mission is important to Aoich, so please do your best.
All right, I'll go. I hope nothing happens here while I'm away.
strings.(흑월성 밖으로 %s의 모습이 사라지자 성주가 공주를 바라본다.): (Once %s disappears beyond Dark Moon Castle, the lord looks at his daughter.)
Are you sure we can entrust something so important to that person? This isn't like you.
strings.아버님도 느끼셨잖아요. 저 사람이 뭔가 다르다는 걸…. 왠지 잘할 것 같: You felt it too, Father. There's something different about them... I just think they'll do well.
True, but you could have entrusted it to someone like Tamori. That's why I ask.
As long as they do a good job, it doesn't matter.
strings.(싫은 여자의 착한 척하는 느낌과 닮아 있어…. 짜증나….): (They remind me of that woman I hate, pretending to be so kind... How irritating...)
I've been waiting. You're the one sent from Dark Moon Castle.
strings.(흑월공주가 말한 장소에 어떤 남자가 서 있다. 평범하게 서 있는 것 같: (A man stands at the place the Dark Moon Princess described. His stance seems ordinary, but his presence is like a wild beast hiding its claws.)
strings.(저 사람이 사막 열두 부족의 수장, 대전사….): (That's the leader of the twelve desert tribes. Their great warrior...)
strings.나는 카디프라고 한다. 흑월성의 주인이 보낸 편지에 나온 인상과 같아 금: My name is Cardiff. You match the description in the Dark Moon Lord's letter, so I recognized you immediately.
I hope the owl that delivered the letter made it back safely...
strings.(카디프가 하늘을 바라보다 걱정스러운 표정을 짓는다.): (Cardiff looks up at the sky with a worried expression.)
strings.미안하네. 손님을 오래 기다리게 했군. 그럼 마이노의 보석 이야기를 해볼: Forgive me. I've kept our guest waiting. Shall we discuss Mino's Jewel?
strings.그냥 빌려주시는 것이 아니었나요?: Weren't you simply going to lend it to us?
strings.급하군. 천천히 이야기를 들어보게. 나도 맘 같아선 바로 빌려주고 싶지만: You're in a hurry. Hear me out. I'd like nothing better than to lend it to you immediately, but...
strings.오래전부터 아오이치와 엘파는 형제와 다름없는 관계로 지내왔다. 그래서 마: Aoich and Elfa have been like brothers since long ago. Lending Mino's Jewel would be no trouble.
The question is whether it still exists.
strings.어, 잠깐만요? 실제로 있는 물건이 아닌가요?: Wait a moment. Isn't it a real object?
Unlike Aoich, which has continued using its jewel, Elfa is a little...
strings.아오이치에서 마이노의 보석을 선물한 건 아주 오래전, 엘파와 아오이치가: Aoich gave it to us long ago, before either Elfa or Aoich became part of the Kingdom of Elias.
Back when Pushuhushu still smoked pipes, as they say.
strings.사막에 피라미드가 지어졌을 때, 당시 지도자는 수많은 보물을 왕족의 무덤: When the pyramid was built in the desert, the leader of that time dedicated many treasures to the royal tomb. Mino's Jewel was among them.
Why put it in a pyramid...?
They say it was buried there as a prayer for the prosperity of their descendants.
strings.그 피라미드라는 곳, 지금은 유적지죠? 혼자 들어가면 위험한가요?: That pyramid is an ancient ruin now, right? Is it dangerous to enter alone?
Even if you're skilled, I wonder whether you can withstand an ancient curse. And the barrier built to keep that curse from spreading has been destroyed...
strings.어떻게 방법이 없을까요?: Isn't there anything we can do?
strings.그러고 보니 지금 타이밍이 나쁘진 않은 것 같네. %s, 그럼 피라미드로: Come to think of it, the timing isn't bad. %s, would you go to the pyramid?
strings.[반 기우]라고, 내가 피라미드 관련 임무를 맡긴 사람이 하나 있어. 마: I've assigned a man named [Ban Giu] a task concerning the pyramid. I'd like you to investigate inside with him while searching for Mino's Jewel...
I'd like to help as well, but my duties keep me rather busy.
strings.어쩔 수 없죠. 피라미드는 카디프 님의 설명대로 그 사람하고 같이 가면: It can't be helped. From what you've said, going into the pyramid with him sounds manageable. I'll head there now.
strings.그래, 조심하고. 엘파의 전사로서 짧게 기도해주겠네. 자네가 무기를 쥔: Yes, take care. As a warrior of Elfa, let me offer a brief prayer. May the hand that holds your weapon always be guided by steadfast faith.
Gone before I even finished the prayer.
That fearless air reminds me of the youngster Ban Giu mentioned...
strings.(불량한 복장 차림의 청년이 %s의 모습을 보자 의아해한다.): (A young man dressed like a delinquent looks puzzled at the sight of %s.)
The one Cardiff assigned a task to...
strings.맞긴 한데, 무슨 일이야? 나에게 무슨 볼 일 있어?: That's me. What's this about? What do you want with me?
strings.(반 기우에게 간단하게 상황을 이야기한다.): (I briefly explain the situation to Ban Giu.)
strings.엥? 여기 그런 게 있었어? 그건 그렇다 치는데, 그 끔찍한 공주하고 엮: Huh? There was something like that here? Well, fine, but getting mixed up with that horrible princess? No thanks. Sigh...
strings.흑월공주를 알아요?: You know the Dark Moon Princess?
strings.알다마다! 얼마나 끔찍…. 아, 어디서 듣고 있을지도 모르니 깜찍하다고: Do I ever! She's so horrib... Ah, she might be listening somewhere, so let's say adorable.
strings.(잔뜩 시달린 거 같네.): (Sounds like she's put him through a lot.)
Ugh, just thinking about it wears me out. I can feel my energy draining away...
strings.나는 피라미드의 중심, '현실'이란 부분에 볼일이 있어. 너, 이름 뭐라: I have business in the burial chamber at the center of the pyramid. What did you say your name was?
Oh, I'm %s. Just call me that.
strings.알았어, %s. 내가 마이노의 보석을 찾는 동안, 댁은 여기 수호자 스핑: Got it, %s. While I search for Mino's Jewel, you deal with the guardian here, the Sphinx.
There's treasure everywhere in here, but finding something with real power isn't easy.
That's where I come in. I can handle that sort of thing without a problem.
strings.진짜를 찾고, 함정을 제거하고. 은근 오래 걸리는 작업이니까 스핑크스를: Finding the real thing, disarming traps... It takes longer than you'd think, so don't come looking for me while you're fighting the Sphinx.
Don't ask that. Just think of it as... dividing up the work.
strings.보니까 실력이 있어 보이는데…. 흑월공주가 보낸 사람이니 걱정할 필요는: You look capable... And the Dark Moon Princess sent you, so I don't need to worry, right?
strings.와, 너 벌써 거길 해결하고 나온 거야?: Wow, you've already finished in there?
strings.그 녀석이 떠오를 정도로 빠르군. 아, 너만큼 나도 훌륭한 솜씨로 마이노: You're fast enough to remind me of someone. Oh, and with skills every bit as fine as yours, I found that Mino-whatever jewel.
strings.(반 기우가 주머니 속에서 묘한 분위기를 지닌 보석을 꺼낸다.): (Ban Giu takes a jewel with a strange aura out of his pocket.)
Hey, don't just stare at it. Give me some praise too.
strings.후후, 나 참 잘했지. 네가 필요한 걸 찾으면서 나도 필요한 걸 찾아냈거: Hehe. I did a great job, didn't I? While finding what you needed, I found what I needed too.
strings.(반 기우가 상당히 기쁜 표정으로 대검 하나를 꺼내 보여준다.): (Looking exceedingly pleased, Ban Giu takes out a greatsword and shows it to me.)
Nothing much. Anyway, the old man's here. If you came all this way, you could at least help.
Your senses are as sharp as ever, brat.
strings.(건너편 그림자 속에서 카디프가 천천히 걸어나온다.): (Cardiff slowly steps out of the shadows across from us.)
You were watching everything, weren't you? We're all done here.
strings.흑월공주가 보낸 당신…, 솜씨가 대단하더군. 크게 기대하진 않았는데 말이: You, the one sent by the Dark Moon Princess... Your skill is remarkable. I hadn't expected so much.
strings.아저씨도 그렇게 생각해? 이런 솜씨는 정말로 그때 이후로는 처음인 것 같: You think so too, old man? I haven't seen skills like that since back then.
strings.이제 스핑크스는 당분간 움직이지 않을 거야. 어서 피라미드의 결계를 원래: The Sphinx won't be moving for a while now. Hurry up and restore the pyramid's barrier.
strings.피라미드는 이 정도면 됐다. 그리고 네가 찾은 그 검의 소유권을 '해룡왕: This will suffice for the pyramid. And I grant ownership of the sword you found to the 'Priestess of the Sea Dragon King.'
I gave my word as the great warrior of the desert. Naturally, I will honor it.
strings.애송이가 반한 여성이 저 대검이 필요했나 봐. 그런데 저게 하필 피라미드: It seems the woman this brat has fallen for needed that greatsword. And it happened to be in the pyramid.
strings.이 피라미드에서 저걸 찾아내는 건 하늘에서 떨어진 동전을 찾는 것과 마찬: Finding it in this pyramid would be like finding a coin dropped from the sky...
Yet he found it. Remarkable. A natural talent.
You don't need to tell them all that.
You're doing this to save the woman you love. Make sure you see it through.
strings.저기 %s, 너는 어디로 가? 흑월성으로 가?: Hey, %s. Where are you heading? Dark Moon Castle?
Now that I have the jewel, I should go back to the princess.
If you don't know where to go afterward, try Poe Mansion. It'll be fun.
strings.(애송이가 장난이 심하군.): (The brat's taking his pranks a little far.)
strings.좋아. 흑월공주한테는 나 봤다는 이야기 하지 말고. 그럼 아저씨도 잘 있: Good. Don't tell the Dark Moon Princess you saw me. Take care, old man. I'm off.
strings.(반 기우가 말이 끝나기 무섭게 사라진다.): (Ban Giu disappears the instant he finishes speaking.)
strings.흑월공주의 청이 있긴 했지만, 덕분에 피라미드를 정리할 수 있었다. 일을: Though you came at the Dark Moon Princess's request, you also helped us set things right in the pyramid. Thank you for your excellent work.
strings.역시 공주의 눈이 정확했어. 아무나 보낼 리도 없겠지만…. 쿨럭쿨럭. 여: The princess has a keen eye, as expected. She wouldn't send just anyone... Cough, cough. The air here is terrible. Let's get out quickly too.
I'll go see the Dark Moon Princess.
Yes, farewell. Give her my regards.
(In front of Dark Moon Castle, the Dark Moon Princess waits in the distance with an anxious expression.)
W-who said I was waiting? I just happened to have business outside.
If Choen were here, I wouldn't have had to wait. Hmph.
Someone I know. We used to... with Iris...
Look what you've made me talk about. Honestly, you...
strings.(흑월공주가 이야기를 하면서 화를 낸다. 이리스의 이름이 흑월공주의 뭔가: (The Dark Moon Princess grows angry as she speaks. The name Iris seems to strike a nerve.)
strings.(마이노의 보석을 흑월공주에게 건네준다.): (I hand Mino's Jewel to the Dark Moon Princess.)
strings.조금 오래 걸린 걸 보니 무슨 일이 있었나봐?: You took a little while. Did something happen?
strings.(흑월공주에게 피라미드를 다녀온 이야기를 한다. 반 기우의 부탁대로 그에: (I tell the Dark Moon Princess about the trip to the pyramid, leaving out Ban Giu as he requested.)
strings.그래? 그런데 그 이야기에 누가 빠진 것 같은 느낌이 드는데, 진짜야?: Really? It feels like someone's missing from that story. Is that really all?
Yes. Cardiff returned to Elfa, and I came here.
strings.알았어. 그리고 수고했어. 보석 관련 일은 이제 네가 신경 쓰지 않아도: All right. And well done. You don't need to worry about the jewel anymore.
Th-thank you. And next time you come to Aoich, tell me about your travels.
strings.너 말이야. 이젠 어디로 갈 거야?: So, where are you going now?
Somewhere I haven't been before, I suppose.
strings.어디로 가야될지 모르겠으면 일단 엘파로 돌아가. 아스 신족 라무아라는 애: If you don't know where to go, head back to Elfa for now. Find an Ases girl named Ramua... No, forget it. Hmph!
Thank you, Princess. See you later.
strings.(솔직하지 못한 사람이라니까….): (She really can't say what she means...)
strings.(…일단 엘파로 가볼까?): (...Shall I head to Elfa for now?)
strings.(엘파 거리에 일반 주민들과는 다른 스타일의 옷을 입은 소녀가 있다.): (A girl in clothes quite different from those of the townspeople stands on an Elfa street.)
Protocol reset... Connecting to the Hyperspace Network... Why does it keep disconnecting...?
Oh, let me introduce myself. I'm...
I'm experiencing a temporary error, so my responses are delayed... This hardly ever happens. It feels like signal interference...
strings.모험가님이 오셔서 그런가? 하여튼, 죄송하게도… 아틀란티스는 타운 포탈로: Is it because you've arrived, adventurer? Anyway, I'm sorry... You can't reach Atlantis through the Town Portal.
strings.그럼 어떻게 갈 수 있나요?: Then how can I get there?
Go past Elfa Harbor to the sandy shore of Orca Beach...
I see. Um... I heard you're one of the Ases, Ramua...
strings.미드가르드 출신이긴 한데, 아스 신족은 선조님들이지, 저는 아니라고 해야: I'm from Midgard, but I suppose I should say the Ases are my ancestors, not me... Still, I carry out work they assign me...
strings.시공간을 이동시키는 머신을 작동시키기 위해선…. '액세스 능력'이라는 특: To operate a machine that moves through space and time... you need someone with a special gift called 'access ability,' and that's...
I don't know how much help I am to Lady Sarasvati...
I can't share the details... without authorization... Confidential work information...
Ugh... There's an error I need to fix. I'm sorry. I'm busy...
It's all right, Ramua. Thank you. I'll be going now.
strings.(그나저나 시공간을 이동시키면 시간을 거슬러 먼 과거나 미래로도 갈 수: (If you can move through space and time, does that mean you can travel back to the distant past, or into the future...?)
strings.(복잡하네. 흐음…. 그러면 좀 쉬다가…. 어, 그런데 왜 반 기우가 말: (Complicated. Hmm... Maybe I'll rest a little... Huh? Why do I feel like I should visit the mansion Ban Giu mentioned?)
strings.(음침하면서도 묘한 분위기가 흘러나오는 장소에 발걸음이 멈췄다.): (My steps come to a halt at a gloomy place with an uncanny atmosphere.)
strings.(반 기우가 말했던 포우 저택이란 곳 같다.): (This must be Poe Mansion, the place Ban Giu mentioned.)
strings.여기가 뭐 재미있는 곳이라고 소개를 해준 거지?: What made him call this place fun?
strings.어, 너 %s, 여기서 뭐 해?: Huh? %s, what are you doing here?
strings.(짙은 그림자 한 편에서 누군가 %s의 모습을 알아차리고 걸어온다.): (Someone notices %s from a patch of deep shadow and walks over.)
What a strange place to run into you.
You must come back to Aoich someday. Understood? I'll hold a proper banquet for you.
strings.그나저나 너. 아오이치를 떠나서 다른 곳으로 갈 줄 알았는데, 여긴 무슨: Anyway, you. I thought you'd leave Aoich for somewhere else. What brings you here?
Someone told me to stop by if I was passing through.
Some people really do give useless advice. Why here...?
strings.이야기가 좀 길어. 우선 이 불길한 저택에 구출하지 않으면 안 되는 사람: It's a long story. For now, I'm here because there's someone I have to rescue from this ominous mansion.
strings.어라, 레비 님을 말씀하시는 건가요?: Oh? Are you talking about Lord Levi?
I'm Lunaresa, a servant of Lady Pandora. You may call me Vampanella if you like.
strings.너, 레비 님을 알고 있어? 네가 누구든 상관없으니까 어서 레비 님에 대: You know Lord Levi? I don't care who you are. Tell me about him, now!!
Lord Levi used to visit here often when he was a child.
strings.그런 이야기는 처음 듣는걸? 그런 이야기는 한 번도 해주신 적이 없어서…: I've never heard that before. He never mentioned anything like that...
You don't know Lord Levi very well, do you? His soul belongs to Lady Pandora.
strings.그게 무슨 소리야? 사람 영혼이 다른 사람의 소유라는 게 말이 돼? 그게: What are you talking about? How can a person's soul belong to someone else? Unless they're a demon or a witch...
Bingo! Lady Pandora is a witch.
strings.무려 전지전능한 마녀! 레비 님의 파괴된 영혼을 부활시키셨죠!: An all-knowing, all-powerful witch, no less! She resurrected Lord Levi's shattered soul!
strings.마왕과의 전투에서 레비 님의 영혼은 판도라 님에게로 돌아왔어요. [아가슈: During the battle with the Demon King, Lord Levi's soul returned to Lady Pandora. He was revived through an [Agasura Contract].
Ah, how great my mistress is.
strings.레비 님이 마왕에게 죽었어? 다 돌아온 게 아니었어?: Lord Levi was killed by the Demon King? They didn't all come back?
strings.(이리스가 함께 했던 파티원들 이야기구나….): (This is about the companions who traveled with Iris...)
strings.웃기지 마. 헛소리 하지 말라고!!: Don't make me laugh. Stop talking nonsense!!
strings.어머, 지금은 무사히 부활하셨으니 그렇게 화낼 필요는 없으시잖아요!: Oh my. He's been safely resurrected now, so there's no need to be so angry!
Sigh. Enough. %s, you! Help me. I said, help me.
strings.레비 님을 데려가시게요?: Are you going to take Lord Levi away?
strings.이 저택을 다 부숴서라도 모셔갈 거야. 그렇게 알라고!: I'll tear this entire mansion down if that's what it takes to bring him back. Remember that!
strings.과연 그렇게 될까요? 공. 주. 님?: Will you really, Your. High. Ness?
I don't want to spend another second here. Let's go.
strings.(저택의 한쪽, 어떤 청년 하나가 멍한 눈빛으로 이쪽을 보고 있다.): (In one part of the mansion, a young man gazes this way with vacant eyes.)
strings.레비 님! 역시 여기에 계셨군요!: Lord Levi! You really are here!
strings.레비 님, 괜찮으세요? 레비… 님?: Lord Levi, are you all right? Lord... Levi?
I thought someone called me. Where? I hear a voice somewhere...
strings.착각인가? 머리가 좀 멍하네…. 아, 판도라 님께 가봐야 해. 판도라 님: Am I imagining it? My head feels a little foggy... Ah, I have to go to Lady Pandora. Lady Pandora...
strings.(레비가 주위를 두리번거리다가 흑월공주를 스쳐 지나간다.): (Levi looks around, then walks straight past the Dark Moon Princess.)
I can't believe it. I'm calling him right in front of him. How can he ignore me...?
strings.(흑월공주가 뭔가 알아차린 듯 졸졸 따라오는 루나레사를 저주스러운 표정으: (As though realizing something, the Dark Moon Princess turns a venomous look on Lunaresa, who is trailing behind.)
strings.그건 주인님의 마법 때문이에요. 위대한 우리 주인님!: It's my mistress's magic. Our great mistress!
I've never heard of magic like that. Never...
Lord Levi's soul is currently cut off from this world, in another space.
strings.이대로 두면 판도라 님과 영원한 티타임을 즐기실텐데, 괜히 끼어들어서 망: If you leave them alone, he'll enjoy an eternal teatime with Lady Pandora. Please don't interfere and spoil it!
strings.그래? 그러면 네 주인을 쓰러뜨리면 끝나는 이야기네?: Is that so? Then all I need to do is defeat your mistress?
strings.주인님께서 레비 님의 영혼을 거두셨으니 주인님의 힘이 사라진다면…. 흐응: My mistress took in Lord Levi's soul, so if her power disappears... Hmm.
strings.공주님께서 판도라 님을 상대할 수 있을까요? 판도라 님은 아가슈라에다가: But can you really face Lady Pandora, Princess? She's an Agasura and a witch who commands advanced magic!
strings.(아가슈라는 알겠는데, 마녀는 또 뭐야?): (I know what an Agasura is, but what's this about a witch?)
Hmph. I had to face Pandora sooner or later anyway.
strings.공주님, 괜찮겠어요?: Princess, will you be all right?
Going to face that Agasura... Pandora.
You can go back if you're scared.
strings.그러면 잔말 말고 따라와. 판도라를 물리치고, 레비 님을 구하자!: Then stop talking and follow me. We'll defeat Pandora and save Lord Levi!
strings.후아, 판도라 님의 충성스러운 부하인 저, 루나레사는 도와드릴 수 없지만: Well now, as Lady Pandora's loyal servant, I, Lunaresa, can't help you. But good luck! ♬
strings.(루나레사가 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 어디론가 사라진다.): (Lunaresa disappears somewhere the instant she finishes speaking.)
strings.…정말 맘에 안 들어. %s, %s, 뭘 그렇게 생각해?: ...I really don't like her. %s, %s! What are you thinking so hard about?
We don't know what Pandora has done to this place, so stay close to me. Understood?
strings.(판도라가 전투에서 패배하고 체념한 듯 흑월공주를 바라본다.): (Defeated in battle, Pandora looks at the Dark Moon Princess with apparent resignation.)
strings.(생각보다 꽤 힘든 전투였어.): (That battle was much harder than I expected.)
A true member of the Black Moon clan. You've changed greatly since before...
Hmph. Don't underestimate me, Pandora the witch.
Now, witch Pandora. This is goodbye! An Agasura like you is...
strings.(흑월공주가 판도라를 향해 활을 겨눈다.): (The Dark Moon Princess aims her bow at Pandora.)
strings.(레비의 등장에 흑월공주가 당황한 나머지 손을 놓치고 만다. 하지만, 레: (Startled by Levi's arrival, the Dark Moon Princess accidentally releases her grip. Levi swings his sword and knocks the flying arrow away.)
strings.(레비라는 사람…. 판도라에게 날아가는 화살을 가볍게 막아냈어.): (That man, Levi... He blocked the arrow flying toward Pandora so easily.)
Lord Levi, I-I... I wasn't trying to attack you.
I'm all right. Please don't worry.
Princess, I have a request. Please do not harm her.
strings.네? 저 여자는 마녀에다가 아가슈라에요!! 몇 년 전에도 저희를 위험에: What? That woman is a witch and an Agasura!! She put us in danger a few years ago too. And now she's done something terrible to you...
strings.(과거에 여러 일이 있었구나….): (A lot must have happened in the past...)
strings.공주님 말씀대로, 판도라와 저의 관계는 계약 그 이상, 그 이하도 아닙니: As you say, Princess, the relationship between Pandora and me is nothing more or less than a contract. This happened under the terms of that contract. Lady Pandora is not at fault.
After what happened back then, I owe my continued life entirely to Lady Pandora's magic... Please, I ask you to stand down.
strings.레비 님 말씀이시니 물러날게요. 저는 레비 님을 구출하고 싶었을 뿐, 마: Since you ask, Lord Levi, I will. I only wanted to rescue you. I don't care whether the witch lives or dies.
Thank you, Princess. And thank you as well.
You have a feeling like Iris's... Ah, never mind.
Dark Moon Princess. Shall we leave?
Lord Levi, are you really all right? Can you go back now? I...
strings.(흑월공주가 레비의 손을 덥썩 잡는다. 그러다 뭔가 깨달았는지 레비의 손: (The Dark Moon Princess eagerly takes Levi's hand. Then, as though realizing something, she lets go and turns her back.)
strings.레비 님, 헤르네가 얼마나 걱정하는지 몰라요. 아, 그럼 말씀 나누고 나: Lord Levi, you have no idea how worried Herne is. Ah, I'll let you finish speaking. I'll wait outside.
%s, come with me. Don't just stand there like an idiot.
Oh, all right. We'll wait outside, then.
strings.(모두 빠져나가자 레비가 판도라를 향해 손을 내민다.): (Once everyone has left, Levi holds out a hand to Pandora.)
strings.판도라 님, 제 목숨은 분명 판도라 님의 것입니다. 하지만 이곳이 아닌: Lady Pandora, my life is certainly yours. But there are things I must do elsewhere.
strings.왕실의 직무에 복귀한 다음, 나중에 다시 찾아뵙겠습니다. 다친 몸을 추스: After resuming my duties at court, I will visit you again. Please take care of your injuries.
strings.(레비가 판도라를 향해 인사를 하고 저택 밖으로 나간다.): (Levi bids Pandora farewell and leaves the mansion.)
strings.레비…, 생명의 대가로 '절실한 감정'을 잃어버린 그대에게 바깥 세상이: Levi... Having lost your 'deepest feelings' in exchange for your life, what meaning does the outside world hold for you?
strings.다른 사람의 의지에 휘말리고, 마왕과 무모한 싸움까지 하고…. 목숨을 잃: Swept along by others' wishes, fighting a reckless battle against the Demon King... You even lost your life.
strings.레비, 그대에게 세상이 줄 수 없는 의미를 주고 싶어. 그대는 내가 그런: Levi, I want to give you meaning that the world cannot. You must understand that I can be that person for you.
I didn't do it because I wanted your thanks.
%s, I have a favor to ask.
strings.나 도와주는 김에 하나만 더 해. 어렵지 않은 일이야. 나중에 흑월성에: Since you're helping me, do one more thing. It isn't difficult. I'll reward you properly when you visit Dark Moon Castle.
Please accompany Lord Levi to Elias. He may still feel unsettled...
I have to go. Father tends to start coughing up blood about now.
Lord Levi, until we meet again. I must leave first to see to my father.
strings.공주님, 혼자 가셔도 괜찮으시겠습니까?: Princess, will you be all right on your own?
strings.보셨지 않으셨어요? 마녀를 혼내줄 정도로 저는 괜찮답니다. 그러니 저기: Didn't you see? I'm well enough to teach a witch a lesson. So please entrust your journey to %s over there.
strings.레비 님. 그러니까… 아, 아니에요. 가볼게요,: Lord Levi, I mean... Ah, never mind. I'll be going.
strings.(흑월공주가 고요하고 어두운 숲속 길을 향해 달려간다.): (The Dark Moon Princess runs toward the quiet, dark forest path.)
Nothing. Let us head to Elias.
Whew. We've reached the palace, so I'll be going now.
I'm thinking of going to Ves or Atlantis.
Please wait until I have finished my audience with His Majesty.
If it's only a moment, that's fine...
strings.(레비가 왕궁으로 들어간 지 얼마 되지 않았을 때, 안에서 시끄러운 소리: (Not long after Levi enters the palace, a loud commotion rises from within.)
strings.기다리게 해드려서 죄송합니다. 폐하께 말씀드렸더니 함께 들어오라는 어명이: I'm sorry to keep you waiting. After I explained to His Majesty, he ordered me to bring you inside.
strings.온 신하들이여, 모험가를 격하게 환영하라…고 하셔서 이렇게 많은 사람이: He said, 'All my subjects, give the adventurer an enthusiastic welcome'... So quite a few people have gathered.
strings.(레비 뒤에서 왕궁 안에 사람들이 잔뜩 서서 기다리고 있다.): (Behind Levi, a large crowd waits inside the palace.)
Please show me the way, Levi.
strings.(레비를 따라 들어간 궁 안, 곤룡포 차림의 한 남성이 인자한 모습으로: (Inside the palace, a man wearing a dragon robe looks on with a kindly expression.)
Your Majesty, this is the adventurer %s.
Oh, so you're the one who rescued Sir Levi? Raise your head.
strings.엘리아스 왕궁에 온 걸 환영하네. 나는 국왕 헤종이네. 그리고 이쪽은 내: Welcome to the Elias Palace. I am King Hejong. And this is my daughter, Herne.
strings.반가워요, 모험가님! 레비 경을 구해주셨다고 들었어요!: It's a pleasure to meet you, adventurer! I heard you saved Sir Levi!
The Dark Moon Princess did more than I did.
The princess sent us a letter by raven, and she had nothing but praise for you.
strings.(흑월공주님이 칭찬을 하셨다고? 왠지 그게 더 무서운데….): (The Dark Moon Princess praised me? Somehow that's even scarier...)
Thank you for helping Sir Levi.
strings.짐도 고맙게 생각하네. 감사 인사는 이쯤에서 하기로 하고, 짐이 그대에게: I am grateful as well. Let us leave the thanks there for now. I have a request for you.
I hear you are searching for Iris, like many other adventurers.
strings.그대의 활약과 자질이 뛰어나기에 그대는 찾을 수 있을 것이다. 하지만,: Your achievements and abilities are exceptional. You may be able to find her. But you will need to get a little closer.
strings.이리스를 찾는 일, 그대는 엘리아스를 찾은 모험가로서 조금 더 신중하게: As an adventurer who has come to Elias, I would like you to approach the search for Iris with particular care.
strings.이리스는 왕국의 은인이기에 꼭 찾았으면 하지만, 쉽지 않지. 많은 이들이: Iris is a benefactor of our kingdom, and I dearly wish to find her. But it is no easy task. Many have searched in vain and given up...
Judging by your expression, you don't intend to give up.
No. I want to find Iris...
If you go to Atlantis, you may discover something about her whereabouts.
strings.해저도시인 아틀란티스는 갈 수만 있지. 꽉 닫혀 있는 곳이네. 그들에게는: You can reach the underwater city of Atlantis, but it is a closed society. They have rules forbidding contact with us surface dwellers.
strings.아틀란티스의 시장 아나스타샤와 긴밀한 사이인 여인이 있다네. 바로 해룡왕: There is a woman who is close to Anastasia, the mayor of Atlantis. Her name is Gatia Su, the Priestess of the Sea Dragon King.
strings.그녀에게 도움을 요청하게. 그러면 아틀란티스의 시장이 도움을 줄지 모르겠: Ask her for help. Then perhaps the mayor of Atlantis will assist you.
strings.무녀님에 대한 행방은 종종 엘리아스에 오시는 선성대사께서 알고 계실 거예: Master Sunsung, who visits Elias from time to time, should know where the priestess is. He's in Ves at present.
Then I leave it to you.
%s, this should really be my duty...
strings.아니요, 레비. 저는 이리스를 찾으러 이곳에 왔으니까 제 일이에요. 레비: No, Levi. I came here to find Iris, so it's my duty too. Just take good care of yourself until we meet again.
I'll come back with Iris. I promise.
strings.(그러면 베스로 가야겠네. 선성대사가 어디 가지 않고 계시려나….): (Then I should head to Ves. I hope Master Sunsung hasn't gone anywhere...)
Well now, an adventurer I haven't seen before.
Indeed. I'm Sunsung. Not Sinsung. Sunsung.
strings.오늘 참 좋은 날씨 아닌가? 베스의 날씨는 좀 습하지만, 이 정도면 천국: Fine weather today, isn't it? Ves is a little humid, but this is paradise. Or perhaps I should say the Pure Land! Haha.
You look like you have something to say.
Yes. His Majesty, the King of Elias, sent me.
strings.(헤종이 가티아 수를 찾아보라던 이야기를 선성에게 한다.): (I tell Sunsung that Hejong asked me to find Gatia Su.)
strings.큰일은 아니고, 그러니까 반 기우 녀석을 도우러 왔다고 생각해도 되려나…: Nothing serious. So perhaps I can take it that you've come to help that boy Ban Giu...
If His Majesty entrusted you with a task, your abilities must be fairly good...
Here, take this. It's called Durendal.
strings.(선성대사가 어디선가 검 하나를 꺼내 %s에게 쥐어준다.): (Master Sunsung produces a sword from somewhere and places it in %s's hands.)
strings.살아있는 자는 해치지 않고, 빛과 어둠을 가를 수 있는 진실된 검이라 알: It is a holy sword, known as a sword of truth that harms no living being and can separate light from darkness.
strings.그런데 왜 이걸 꺼내신 거죠?: But why have you brought it out?
strings.가티아는 지금 해룡왕의 근처에 있지. 그런데 지금 해룡왕의 기운이 악의로: Gatia is near the Sea Dragon King right now. His aura is filled with malice, so she is keeping watch over his condition.
Ban Giu tried to use this to drain the Sea Dragon King's energy and calm him, but he failed. Durendal is surprisingly difficult to wield if it isn't compatible with its user...
In any case, he returned here, left the sword with me, then headed straight back.
strings.그런데 마침 자네가 나한테 가티아를 찾는다고 왔지. 이건 우연이 아닐지도: And now you have come to me looking for Gatia. Perhaps this is no coincidence. Maybe the sword wanted to meet you.
Hold the sword and take a deep breath.
strings.(선성대사의 말에 따라 심호흡을 해보자…. 무거웠던 검이 갑자기 가벼워졌: (I take a deep breath as Master Sunsung instructs... The heavy sword suddenly feels light. What is this...?)
strings.자네와 잘 맞는 검인 것 같군. 내가 이런 건 한 번에 알아보거든. 하하: It seems the sword suits you. I can spot these things at a glance. Haha.
strings.(신비한 기운이 느껴져. 이건….): (I feel a mysterious energy. This is...)
strings.자네, 정신 차리게. 쉽게 얻은 힘은 정신 차리지 않는 사이에 쉽게 무너: Keep your wits about you. Power gained easily can just as easily fall apart while you're off guard.
I think I'm all right so far.
strings.그걸 가지고 크투가 유적으로 가서, 깊은 곳에 '식어버린 심장'이란 공간: Take it to the Kthuka Ruins and look deep within for a place called the 'Chilled Heart.'
strings.반 기우가 아무리 이리스를 도와 모험을 하는 실력자라 하더라도 강력한 신: However skilled Ban Giu may be from adventuring with Iris, facing a powerful divine beast alone is too much for him.
strings.(유적이 흔들리면서 그 틈으로 누군가의 목소리가 섞여 들려온다.): (The ruins shake, and voices reach me through the rumbling.)
strings.역시, 역시 듀랜달이 없으면 무리인가?: I knew it. Is this impossible without Durendal?
Ban, fall back! We have no choice but to retreat for now.
strings.누구지? 하나는 반 기우의 목소리인데, 다른 하나는…?: Who's that? One voice is Ban Giu's, but the other...?
I can't retreat. I can't leave you behind.
strings.전 해룡왕님을 모시는 무녀, 해룡왕님께 무슨 일이 생긴다면 저는 여기서…: I am the priestess who serves the Sea Dragon King. If anything happens to him, I must remain here...
strings.(화가 잔뜩 난 것 같은 거대한 생물의 울음소리가 유적을 흔든다. 살아있: (The cry of an enormous, furious creature shakes the ruins. Its overwhelming presence is enough to make living beings collapse in terror.)
strings.(일단 가보자. 가서 어떻게든….): (I have to go in. Somehow, I'll...)
strings.(해무가 가득해 앞이 잘 보이지 않아 반 기우가 천천히 주위를 살핀다.): (The sea fog is so thick that Ban Giu can barely see as he slowly surveys the area.)
strings.(해룡왕의 눈이 감기고, 거대한 몸이 천천히 물 밑으로 가라앉는 느낌으로: (The Sea Dragon King closes his eyes. His enormous body begins sinking slowly, then swiftly descends beneath the water.)
strings.해룡왕 님의 기력이 모두 소진됐습니다. 다시 잠드신 것 같군요. 다행입니: The Sea Dragon King's strength is completely spent. He seems to have fallen asleep again. Thank goodness.
That's a relief, but now I owe this one again. Anyway, thanks for helping.
Durendal... You seem better at using it than I am.
strings.해룡왕 님의 기력을 모두 소진한…. 반, 저분은 누구죠?: The one who exhausted the Sea Dragon King's strength... Ban, who is this person?
strings.가티아 씨, 저 사람은 사막에서 듀랜달을 구할 때 만났던 친구야. 이번에: Gatia, this is the friend I met in the desert when I was looking for Durendal. They've helped us again.
Ah, let me introduce myself properly. I am the priestess... Gatia Su.
strings.그대의 도움에 감사드립니다. 모험가여. 그런데 여기까진 무슨 일로 오신: Thank you for your help, adventurer. But what brings you all the way here?
strings.(이리스를 찾기 위해 여행 중이며, 아틀란티스로 가려면 가티아 수의 도움: (I explain that I'm traveling in search of Iris, and came because I need Gatia Su's help to reach Atlantis.)
strings.(가티아 수가 이야기를 듣고 잠시 생각에 잠긴다.): (Gatia Su listens, then falls into thought for a moment.)
strings.무녀님은 아직 일이 남았어. 해룡왕이 잠들긴 했어도…. 그건 그렇고, 듀: The priestess still has work to do. Even if the Sea Dragon King is asleep... Anyway, why didn't Durendal suit me...?
strings.너는 좀 다른가? (긁적긁적): Is there something different about you? (Scratch, scratch.)
strings.저는 고대시절부터 해룡왕을 모시는 무녀 일족의 일원…. 과거엔 꽤 많은: I belong to a line of priestesses who have served the Sea Dragon King since ancient times... There were once many of us, but now I am the only one left.
strings.무녀는 인간과 해룡왕, 서로 다른 존재인 둘을 잇는 위치에 있습니다. 해: A priestess serves as a bridge between humans and the Sea Dragon King, two very different beings. Through his power, I may have lived longer than my appearance suggests.
strings.듀랜달 덕분에 폭주하는 해룡왕을 말릴 수 있지만, 또 어떤 일이 일어날지: Durendal allowed us to stop his rampage, but we do not know what else may happen. The influence of some power he currently holds...
strings.(가티아 수의 이야기가 끝나기도 전에 물 속에서 흐릿한 모습이 무언가가: (Before Gatia Su can finish, a hazy form appears from the water. It looks like a smaller phantom of the Sea Dragon King.)
strings.난 괜찮네, 가티아 수. 그리고 형제여, 네 덕분에 정신을 차릴 수 있었: I am all right, Gatia Su. And you, my kin, I regained my senses thanks to you!
strings.헛, 해룡왕님, 괜찮으신가요?: Ah! Sea Dragon King, are you well?
strings.가티아 수, 다시 한 번 말하지만, 나는 괜찮네! 내 몸이 회복을 하기: Gatia Su, I say again, I am all right! My body has fallen asleep to recover. I'm sorry that appearing like this to offer my thanks is all I can manage.
strings.내 조금만 쉬고 나서 가티아 자네를 부르겠네…. 아, 시간이 됐군. 미안: After I rest a little, I'll call for you, Gatia... Ah, my time is up. Forgive me, everyone...
strings.(해룡왕의 영체가 서서히 흐릿해진다.): (The Sea Dragon King's spirit slowly fades.)
Sea Dragon King... What a relief...
The Sea Dragon King seems to think highly of your 'power.'
strings.해룡왕도 영물이라는 건가? 아, 그러고 보니 너 이리스를 찾고 있으면 같: So the Sea Dragon King really is a creature of great spiritual insight? Oh, come to think of it, if you're looking for Iris, you must know some of her traveling companions.
I've met Zoe, Muwen, the Dark Moon Princess, and Levi.
strings.우리는 여기 있으니 됐고, 초엔도 봤어?: And we're here, so that covers us. Have you seen Choen too?
At first, I thought she was a pretty decent woman. I never imagined she'd do something like that. If you ever see her, don't let her fool you.
Despite her appearance, she does whatever she wants. And in the end... she betrayed us... Or maybe I should say she seemed to enjoy what was happening. Anyway!
strings.그 정도의 인성이면 분명 아가슈라였을 거야. 대체 원하는 게 뭐였기에 우: With a character like that, she must have been an Agasura. What did she want so badly that she traveled with us?
strings.(잘 모르겠다. 대체 무슨 일이 있었는지….): (I don't understand. What on earth happened...?)
strings.말씀 중에 죄송합니다. 아틀란티스로 가신다고 하셨죠?: Forgive me for interrupting. You said you were going to Atlantis, correct?
Our recent battle has opened the waterway to Atlantis.
If you continue down along the coast, you may be able to reach it.
strings.저 %s, 무리인 줄 알지만, 조금만 도와주실 수 있으신가요?: Um, %s. I know it's a lot to ask, but could you help us a little longer?
strings.가티아…. 혹시 불의 무녀 때문에 그래?: Gatia... Is this about the Priestess of Fire?
strings.네, 그렇습니다. 해룡왕님께 위해를 가하는 존재들이 뭔가 꾸미고 있는데,: Yes. Those who mean the Sea Dragon King harm are plotting something. To be honest, I fear we cannot handle it with our strength alone...
I'm sorry I couldn't be more help...
strings.(그들도 아가슈라인가…? 내가 해도 되는 걸까? 어쩌면 뭔가 알아낼 수: (Are they Agasura too...? Should I get involved? Maybe I could learn something.)
You remind me of Miss Iris. That pure wish to help others...
Please follow me. We will go to the Priestess of Fire.
Of course. I'll go anywhere you go, Gatia.
strings.아, 반. 반은 들어갈 수 없는 곳입니다. 무녀와 특별한 힘을 가진 사람: Ah, Ban. You cannot enter this place. Only priestesses and those with a special power may do so... Please wait outside.
strings.(뭐야, 이 두 사람…. 후우, 일단 그 불의 무녀가 있는 곳에 가볼까?: (What's going on with these two...? Sigh. For now, let's go see this Priestess of Fire.)
Your sudden arrival caught me off guard, but...
You're no ordinary person. To make me struggle like this...
strings.해룡왕의 무녀…, 이제 하다 하다 다른 사람의 힘을 빌려 여기까지 오다니: Priestess of the Sea Dragon King... Now you've stooped to borrowing someone else's power to reach me. How treacherous.
Ugh, this is infuriating. I was so close to bringing down the Sea Dragon King...
strings.그만둬요. 대체 여기서 이러는 이유가 뭐죠?: Stop this. Why are you doing any of this?
Who are you? This has nothing to do with... Ah, you are...
strings.불꽃의 무녀, 해룡왕님을 어떻게 할 생각이었죠?: Priestess of Flame, what were you planning to do to the Sea Dragon King?
strings.그걸 왜 내게 묻지? 저 못된 바다의 마신을 물리쳐야 내 아이들이 안전해: Why ask me? My children won't be safe until that wicked demon god of the sea is defeated.
I know you're trying to send the Sea Dragon King berserk and annihilate all of Kthuka.
W-wait a moment. Who told you that? Who said someone was making him rampage...?
strings.물의 무녀 가티아, 역시 너지?: Gatia, Priestess of Water. So it was you, wasn't it?
You seem to have seriously misunderstood. Explain yourself.
strings.무녀가 자신이 모시는 존재를 이용한다는, 그런 부정한 일을 할 수 있다고: Do you believe a priestess could commit the sacrilege of exploiting the being she serves? Koa, Priestess of Fire. What have you heard?
strings.몇 년 전부터 시작된 해룡왕의 불안정한 상태는 네 짓이 아니라 이건가?: Are you saying you aren't responsible for the Sea Dragon King's instability over the past few years?
I swear it in the name of the Sea Dragon King and every god.
strings.당신 분명 초엔에게서 그 이야기륻 들었을테죠? 초엔의 어떤 점을 보고 믿: You heard that story from Choen, didn't you? What did you see in her that made you trust her?
You are Agasura. Surely you did not trust each other.
strings.[기어 다가드는 혼돈]이 그럴 리 없다. 살아있는 불꽃인 나를…. 아,: The [Crawling Chaos] would never do that. To me, the Living Flame... Ah, perhaps I... And Choen...
Koa, you were used. She must be the one responsible.
I am Agasura, and so is Choen...
strings.됐다. 물의 무녀여. 원하는 것이 뭐지?: Enough. Priestess of Water, what do you want?
strings.특별히 없습니다. 그냥 불필요한 싸움을 피하고 싶을 뿐…. 불의 무녀인: Nothing in particular. I only wish to avoid needless conflict... As the Priestess of Fire, you should understand.
Think about whether the Sea Dragon King has ever taken a life carelessly.
Very well. I will withdraw this time.
strings.그러나 조금이라도 내 심기를 거슬리게 한다면 가만두지 않겠어. 이곳을 비: But cross me even slightly, and I will not stand idle. I will cover this place and all of Jiendia in my flames!
strings.(코아가 등을 돌리자 주위에 뜨거운 불꽃이 피어오른다. 불꽃은 이내 코아: (Koa turns away, and searing flames rise around her. They engulf her, then vanish without a trace.)
Fortunately, she seems to have understood.
strings.초엔 팜이라는 사람이 아가슈라란 거죠? 그리고 불의 무녀 코아를 선동한: So Choen Palm is an Agasura? And she stirred up Koa, the Priestess of Fire... Why?
strings.정확히는 알 수 없습니다…. 하지만, 어떤 일을 꾸미고 있는 것은 틀림없: I cannot say for certain... But she is undoubtedly plotting something.
strings.그나마 다행인 건 불의 무녀 코아가 아가슈라로서 가진 자신의 모습을 보여: At least Koa did not reveal her true Agasura form.
strings.자신을 따르는 쿠쿠리족이 피해를 보게 되면 조금 전과 같은 격전은 피할: If the Kukuri tribe who follow her were harmed, another fierce battle like the one just now would be unavoidable.
Choen Palm seems to be different.
Considering that she deceived her own kind and tried to render the Sea Dragon King powerless...
strings.정확히는 알 수 없지만, 당신이 이리스 님을 찾을 때 답을 얻을 수 있을: I cannot be certain, but perhaps you will find the answer when you find Iris.
We have no more business here. Shall we go outside? Ban will be waiting.
strings.(가티아 수가 반에게 간단하게 상황이 마무리됐다고 설명한다.): (Gatia Su briefly explains to Ban that the situation has been resolved.)
It was nothing. I should head back and let Master Sunsung know.
strings.그럴 필요 없어. 선성대사에게는 내가 다녀올 테니 너는 원래 가려던 길: No need. I'll go see Master Sunsung. You can continue on your way.
Yes, please do. There's no need to trouble yourself with another trip back.
strings.절 도와주신 건 모두를 위한 것이었으니, 아틀란티스에 방문할 자격을 드리: Your help was for everyone's sake, so I grant you permission to visit Atlantis.
strings.(가티아의 손끝에서 푸른 빛이 나타나 %s의 몸을 감싸고 사라진다.): (A blue light appears at Gatia's fingertips, surrounds %s's body, then fades.)
strings.아틀란티스로 가면 아나스타샤 시장에게 가보세요. 제가 보내서 왔다고 하면: When you reach Atlantis, visit Mayor Anastasia. Tell her I sent you, and she should offer you some assistance.
strings.고마워요. 그런데 아틀란티스는 어느 쪽에 있나요?: Thank you. Which way is Atlantis?
strings.오르카 해변에 잠수정이 있으니까 그걸 타세요. 아나스타샤 시장은 아틀란티: There's a submersible at Orca Beach. Take that. Mayor Anastasia is near the building you see as soon as you arrive in Atlantis. And...
I pray that you will find Iris.
strings.그럴게요. 꼭 그럴게요. 이리스를 만나야 하는 게 제가 여행을 하는 이유: I will. I certainly will. Finding Iris is the reason for my journey.
strings.(이제 오르카 해변으로 가볼까….): (Shall I head to Orca Beach now...?)
strings.(%s의 뒤에서 배웅하던 반 기우와 가티아 수의 눈이 마주친다.): (After seeing %s off, Ban Giu and Gatia Su meet each other's eyes.)
strings.그런데 %s, 저 녀석이 이리스를 찾을 수 있을까? 다 돌아왔는데, 이리: Do you think %s can find Iris? Everyone came back except her, and no matter how hard we searched, we couldn't find her...
strings.그건 모릅니다만, 어쩌면 저분 끝에 이리스 님이 있을 것 같은 기분이 듭: I don't know. But somehow, I feel Iris may be waiting at the end of that person's path.
strings.반은 이제 어디로 가시죠?: Where will you go now, Ban?
Me? I'll... Well, somewhere I can make a little money, like before.
I'm going back to the Sea Dragon King's dwelling now. So...
You may visit from time to time, if you think of me.
I'll be going now. Until we meet again.
strings.(아름다운 해변 저편, 하늘을 향해 높게 수상한 것들이 뻗어 있어 웅장한: (Beyond the beautiful beach, strange structures stretch high into the sky, creating a majestic sight.)
strings.아름다운 해변인데…. 저긴 뭐지? 유적 같은 건가?: What a beautiful beach... But what's that? Some sort of ruin?
I've never heard of anything like this being here...
strings.(한참 동안 바다 너머 유적을 바라보고 있던 %s의 귓가에 어떤 목소리가: (As %s gazes at the ruins across the sea, a voice reaches their ears.)
strings.어디서 들리는 거지? 저 석탑인가?: Where is that coming from? That stone tower?
strings.(해변의 작은 언덕 위에 세워진 빛나는 석탑이 진동을 일으키고 있다.): (A glowing stone tower on a small rise above the beach is vibrating.)
strings.(석탑이 날 이끌고 있어.): (The stone tower is drawing me toward it.)
strings.(어떤 소녀의 모습이 흐릿하게 보였다 사라지기를 반복한다. 뭐라고 말하고: (A girl's hazy figure flickers in and out of sight. She seems to be saying something, but I cannot hear it.)
strings.(소녀가 고개를 끄덕이다 바다 건너 유적을 바라본다. 잠시 후, 소녀의: (The girl nods, then looks toward the ruins across the sea. A moment later, she disappears from sight.)
I need to go to Atlantis...
strings.(방금 나왔던 소녀가 신경 쓰여….): (But I can't stop thinking about that girl...)
strings.그런데 저 유적으로 가려면 어떻게 해야 하지?: How can I get to those ruins?
strings.(석탑이 웅웅 거리고 다시 진동을 일으키고 있다.): (The stone tower hums and begins vibrating again.)
It seems to want me to touch it...
strings.(제나디아 안으로 이동하려면 석탑에서 이동하기 메뉴를 사용하세요.): (To enter Xenadia, use the Travel menu at the stone tower.)
strings.(유적 안은 신비한 느낌이 가득하지만, 온갖 몬스터와 정리되지 않은 길: (The ruins are filled with a mysterious air, but all the monsters and tangled paths make them feel like a maze.)
strings.(저 멀리 대화를 나누는 두 사람이 보인다.): (Two people can be seen talking in the distance.)
I'll ask them. Maybe they know this place.
With my strength, even dealing with a few monsters is difficult.
Not at all, Berkut. You've been a great help.
strings.그러면 조금 쉬었다가 계속해볼게. 정 안되면 다음에 강철도시에서 사람을: Then I'll rest a little and keep trying. If it proves impossible, I'll gather some people from the Steel City next time, Sister Maris.
strings.고맙습니다. 저기 혹시 저분, 베르쿠트 씨가 부르신 건가요?: Thank you. Um, did you invite that person, Berkut?
strings.모험가가 올 거라 생각은 했지만, 어떻게 온 거지? 그리고 자네는 누구지: I expected adventurers to come eventually, but how did you get here? And who are you?
Oh, I'm %s... I'm traveling in search of Iris. And...
strings.(베르쿠트와 시스터 마리스에게 이리스를 찾는 여행의 시작부터 여기까지 오: (I briefly explain to Berkut and Sister Maris how my search for Iris began and how I came to be here.)
strings.신기하지? 그 석탑을 일종의 전송장치라고 생각하면 될 것 같아. 이리스를: Amazing, isn't it? Think of that stone tower as a kind of transportation device. You're looking for Iris? Well, nice to meet you. I should have introduced myself sooner.
strings.나는 강철도시 출신의 엔지니어…. 뭐 사람들이 마이스터라 부르는 베르쿠트: I'm Berkut, an engineer from the Steel City... Or a Meister, as people call me. This is Sister Maris. Say hello.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
strings.내가 설명해주지. 시스터는 조금 쉬어야 해서…. 제나디아는 고대 유적이: I'll explain. The sister needs a little rest... Yes, Xenadia is an ancient ruin. It appeared off Orca Beach like this not long ago.
strings.나도 처음엔 믿지 않았어. 내 스승인 이카로스가 해변을 산책 중에 발견했: I didn't believe it at first either. My teacher, Icarus, made such a fuss after spotting it on a walk along the beach.
strings.여길 탐사한다고 하더니 소식이 끊겨서 여기에 와봤더니 진짜로 고대 유적이: He said he was going to explore it, then I stopped hearing from him. So I came here, and sure enough, there were ancient ruins.
strings.어떻게 들어가는 방법을 찾아 와보니 시스터들이 스승이 만들었던 기계들과: I found a way inside and discovered the sisters struggling with machines my teacher had made.
strings.뭘 만들었는지 알 순 없지만, 통제가 안 되는 기계 덩어리들을 두고 어디: I don't know what he built, but where did he disappear to, leaving those uncontrollable heaps of machinery behind? The man's so irresponsible. Sigh.
And now I'm stuck dealing with it. What was he doing in a sacred place like this...?
I see. Oh, Sister, you seem to have something you want to say...
Your name is %s, correct? You said you were looking for someone called Iris...
Somehow, I feel I can tell you this.
strings.마리스 시스터, 미안한데 잠깐 기다려주겠어?: Sister Maris, sorry, but could you wait a moment?
If you ask it, Berkut, gladly...
strings.%s…라고 했지? 일단 이 앞에 방해되는 존재들을 같이 처리했으면 좋겠어: %s, was it? First, I'd like us to clear away the creatures blocking the path ahead. Will you help?
You're skilled. We finished more easily than I expected.
Thank you. Please tell me what you were going to say.
strings.베르쿠트 님을 제외하고 여기 있는 신관과 시스터는 이곳의 주인이시자 여신: Apart from Berkut, the priests and sisters here are all Pluton Dragons who serve Seres, the goddess and mistress of this place.
strings.(이야기를 듣자마자 입안에 있던 물을 뿜고 말았다.): (The moment I hear that, I spit out the water in my mouth.)
strings.헛, 죄송합니다. 플루톤 드래곤이요? 하지만, 이렇게 인간의 모습이신데…: Oh! I'm sorry. Pluton Dragons? But you look human...
The Pluton Dragons are a race of dragons created by Lady Seres's will.
strings.때는 바야흐로 마왕 비스트와의 결전…. 세레스 님께서 패하시면서 혼돈의: During the decisive battle against the Demon King Beast... at the moment Lady Seres was defeated and returned to the realm of chaos...
strings.저희의 시공간은 멈췄습니다. 정확히는 굳어버렸군요. 그렇게 망각의 공간에: Our space and time stopped. Or, more precisely, froze solid. Trapped in a space of oblivion, we spent an eternity there.
Someone spoke to us occasionally, but I do not know who it was.
I am older than you might think...
No, that's not what I meant. I wondered whether you knew why you came back.
strings.그것까진 잘 모르겠습니다. 지엔디아의 땅으로 돌아와 보니 시간이 많이 흘: I don't know that much. When we returned to Jiendia, a great deal of time had passed.
We wondered whether Lady Seres had returned, but she had not.
I see. Still, there must be a reason.
strings.그래서 찾고 있습니다. 지금 시대에 맞는 모습으로 나중에 세레스 님이 찾: That is why we are searching. We must adapt to this age and prepare for the day Lady Seres comes to us.
Come now. Keep your spirits up.
strings.모험가여…. 혹시 당신은 데르족인가요?: Adventurer... Are you perhaps one of the Tyr?
No. I'm just an ordinary person. I do know of the Tyr, though...
strings.오래전 벨로라스의 모험가들이 제나디아를 사랑해서 많이 오곤 했거든요. 그: Long ago, adventurers from Beloras loved Xenadia and came here often. The Tyr did as well...
strings.(벨로라스면 오래전 벨로스의 이름인가?): (Was Beloras the old name for Belos?)
Since I've come here, I'd like to explore a little more.
strings.생각보다 넓은 곳이라 길을 헤매실 수도 있지만, 천천히 둘러보세요: It's larger than you might expect, so you may lose your way. But please take your time looking around.
strings.뭔가 도와드릴 일이 없을까요?: Is there anything I can help with?
strings.착하다고 해야 하나, 오지랖이 넓다고 해야 하나. 나는 스승님이 또 뭘: Should I call you kindhearted, or just unable to mind your own business? I'm going to see what else my teacher left behind. Take care.
strings.(베르쿠트가 익숙한 듯한 발걸음으로 어딘가를 향해 사라진다.): (Berkut heads off somewhere with practiced steps.)
strings.그럼 모험가님, 이 곳까지 찾아오신 용기와 그 마음에 경의를 표하며, 약: Then, adventurer, in honor of the courage and goodwill that brought you here, I will ask a small favor.
strings.제나디아가 다시 모습을 보이면서 이곳의 힘을 노리는 불경한 [몬스터]가: Since Xenadia reappeared, a profane [monster] has been seeking this place's power.
strings.지금 그것이 어디 있는지는 알 수 없어 저희도 찾고 있습니다. 만약 그걸: We do not know where it is at present and are searching ourselves. If you see it, please defeat it as you did the creatures earlier.
strings.그리고 그 존재에게서 나오는 [성스러운 파편]을 저에게 가져다주셨으면 합: And please bring me the [Sacred Fragment] that it leaves behind.
Yes, I will. I'll be back.
strings.(시스터 마리스가 눈을 감자마자 세상이 환한 빛으로 가득한다.): (The moment Sister Maris closes her eyes, the world fills with brilliant light.)
It feels like warmth is filling my heart...
strings.(성스러운 느낌으로 빛나는 나무가 바람에 흔들리고 있다.): (A tree shining with a sacred glow sways in the wind.)
strings.(어떤 소녀의 모습이 흐릿하게 떠오른다. 할 말이 있는 것 같은 표정이다: (A girl's hazy figure appears. Her expression suggests she has something to say.)
Do you... want to talk? All right. Go ahead.
At last... This day has come.
I've waited for you for so long.
strings.(흐릿하게만 보이던 소녀의 모습이 점점 선명해진다.): (The girl's faint outline gradually grows clearer.)
strings.마치 앞에 있는 것처럼 보여…. 그런데 그게 무슨 말이죠? 오랫동안 기다: It's as though you're right in front of me... But what do you mean? You've waited a long time...?
strings.여기까지 오느라 힘들었지?: It was hard coming all this way, wasn't it?
strings.(미소에서 어떤 감정이 느껴져…. 이건, 이건…. 이리스라는 이름을 들었: (I feel something in that smile... This is... like the feeling I had when I heard the name Iris...)
strings.(소녀의 눈가에 눈물이 맺히고 이내 떨어지고 만다.): (Tears gather in the girl's eyes, then begin to fall.)
strings.아니…. 그냥 알고 있었던 사람처럼 편하게 느껴졌어요. 오랫동안 기다렸다: No... You just felt familiar, like someone I'd known before. When you said you'd waited a long time, I suddenly felt something...
Loneliness. I wondered how lonely you must have been...
I see... Just as I'd expect of the child Iris brought here by opening the path of dreams...
Iris... No, the Tyr are beings I shaped myself.
strings.내가 사랑으로 아끼는 이 대지, 그리고 그 위에 내 혼이 담긴 빛의 씨앗: This land I cherish so dearly, and the children born upon it from seeds of light containing my soul... Though I can never see them again...
strings.이리스…. 그 작은 아이만은 지금도 힘차게, 최선을 다해서 살아가고 있어: Iris... That little child alone still lives on, bravely doing all she can.
strings.(소녀가 흐르는 눈물을 닦고 애써 웃음 짓는다.): (The girl wipes away her tears and forces a smile.)
strings.이리스, 나의 소중한 아이 이리스…. 그 아이가 지금 아픈 건 나 때문이: Iris, my precious child Iris... The pain she suffers now is my fault...
strings.그, 그렇게 생각하지 마세요. 이리스는…. 이리스는 금방 일어서서 웃을: P-please don't think that. Iris... Iris will get back on her feet and smile again. I'll find her and see for myself.
strings.지금 말하고 있는 건 제나디아의 잔영. 널 만났으니 이제 사라지겠지. 그: What speaks to you now is an echo of Xenadia. Now that I've met you, I'll fade away. But before that, I have something to give you.
strings.오르카 해변에 최초의 별빛이 쏟아지던 시대, 생명과 노래의 씨앗을 뿌렸노: In the age when the first starlight fell upon Orca Beach, I sowed the seeds of life and song.
My existence is fleeting and frail. Though I fade as a fragment of this age...
strings.세계를 위해 데르족을 남긴 것처럼, 이곳에 남아있는 힘을 모두 이 젊은: As I left the Tyr for the sake of the world, I now leave all the power that remains here to this young adventurer.
strings.지엔디아의 생명은 기억하거라. 여기 달과 꽃과 초목의 주인인 세레스가 모: Let all life in Jiendia remember: here, Seres, mistress of the moon, flowers, and growing things, blessed this adventurer's path...
strings.(세레스가 모험가를 향해 손을 뻗는다. 빛의 나무에서 빛이 흘러나와 모험: (Seres reaches toward the adventurer. Light flows from the luminous tree and wraps around them.)
strings.(세레스의 잔영이 점점 흐려진다. 금방이라도 사라져 없어질 것 같다.): (Seres's echo grows fainter. She looks as though she could vanish at any moment.)
Until the day when all become one...
strings.이리스…, 이리스는 대체 어디 있는 걸까…?: Iris... Where on earth are you...?
strings.세레스 님과 만나게 된 건 결코 우연이 아니겠죠?: Meeting Lady Seres couldn't have been a coincidence, could it?
I'll find Iris and tell her what you wished, Lady Seres...
strings.(성스러운 느낌으로 빛나는 나무가 다시 바람에 흔들린다.): (The tree shining with a sacred glow sways in the wind once more.)
Are you all right? You lost consciousness and gave me quite a fright.
Ah, this is... Sister, I'm all right.
strings.(세레스 님의 잔영을 봤던 일을 간단하게 설명한다.): (I briefly explain that I saw Lady Seres's echo.)
strings.시스터께선 세레스 님의 흔적을 찾고 있다고 들었는데요…. 그런데 어떻게: I heard you were searching for traces of Lady Seres... How did you know to send me there?
strings.그게 아닙니다. 세레스 님께서 이끄신 것뿐입니다. 어쩌면 제가 아닌 세레: I did no such thing. Lady Seres guided you herself. Perhaps it was her you saw and followed, rather than me.
strings.모험가님이 찾는 이리스라는 분이 데르족의 유일한 후손이라면…. 이 모든: If the Iris you seek is the sole descendant of the Tyr... then all of this is a bond Lady Seres has given you...
Surely it means she has faith in you.
strings.세레스 님의 가호가 느껴집니다. 감사합니다, 모험가님…. 이 기운은 정말: I can feel Lady Seres's blessing. Thank you, adventurer... It has been so long since I felt this aura.
strings.저희는 앞으로도 이곳을 재건하면서 세레스 님의 메시지를 전파하고, 이리: We will continue rebuilding this place, spreading Lady Seres's message, and considering how we may help Iris.
Thank you. I'll be going now.
Yes. May your path be filled with Lady Seres's blessings.
strings.(아틀란티스로 가려면 그러니까… 오르카 해변에 있는 잠수정을 타면 된다고: (To reach Atlantis... I was told to take the submersible at Orca Beach, right?)
strings.세레스 님…. 세레스 님께서 사랑한 세계는 지금도 정말 아름다워요. 하지: Lady Seres... The world you loved is still so beautiful. And yet...
